Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

Two of Project Runway's favorite challenges, the flower store and the hardware store, are combined for the ultimate “hard and soft” challenge. programmes.st: A Little Bit Country, A Little Bit Rock N Roll
programmes.d: The large teams dissolve, and the designers are now asked to work in pairs. The teams must make two looks—one red carpet and one performance—for country music star Miranda Lambert.
The designers must work in teams of two to create looks for “mature” women, who also serve as their clients and models for this challenge. Joan and Melissa Rivers guest judge.

Before the challenge begins, the designers are asked to re-pick their teams. Then, in teams of two, the designers are tasked with making a prom dress out of duct tape. In addition to the Runway, they are also judged on their work by a group of high school students, whose votes factor into their final score. Two designers are eliminated.

Regrouping once again, the judges decide which designers they would like to see work together, and the teams are separated into two teams of four. The designers must make cohesive looks for the male dance troupe Thunder From Down Under. Not only must they execute menswear, but their designs must be able to “tear away” onstage as part of their performance.

In new teams of twos and threes, the designers make a ready-to-wear look for Lord and Taylor, inspired by their famous rose design. The winning design is manufactured and sold at Lord and Taylor for Spring 2013.

In pairs again, the designers use HP technology and inspiration drawn from the Guggenheim Museum to create two looks: one avant-garde and a second ready-to-wear piece. They are also able to design their fabric for this challenge.

After working in teams all season, the designers are relieved when they receive the news that they will now be working on their own. However, some of the eliminated designers return to act as assistants and help the competitors complete their look. For this challenge, the designers must make a Spring 2013 editorial look to be worn by actress Jordana Brewster and featured in Marie Claire.

When the Shane Gang arrive at a cavern overrun by thieves terrorizing the good townfolk, they decide to use Pronto as bait, hoping the thieves will eliminate each other as each strives to be the first to capture the valuable molenoid-the only one the Eastern Caverns have ever seen. However, their plan goes awry when Underlord Holt arrives and commands the thieves to work together to bring him Pronto-dead or alive!

When the Shane Gang travel to the Auroris Mine, they discover a legendary monster carved out of stone attacking the mines-the Pyritor. Trixie studies the legend to help them locate the creature's home and put a stop to its reign of terror, but first they must confront the true nature of the beast, and its assistant!

Determined to up his game against Stone Warriors, Kord visits a famous Eastern Technician for help creating a new blaster upgrade. Building the new upgrade is difficult...but working with the Technician is practically impossible!

A winter-time holiday has arisen in the Eastern Caverns around the mysterious "Giver," who makes an annual visit to deliver slugs to the people of the East. programmes.st: The Fall of the Eastern Champion
programmes.d: Junjie recounts the ancient history of the Eastern Caverns and his ancestors, and the events that led to his downfall and transformation from the Eastern Champion to the Dark Slinger.
When Pronto accidentally uses the Emperor's sword blaster, he can suddenly do no wrong. Lady Dai-Fu manipulates Underlord Holt into trapping the Shane Gang with a new superweapon: the Iron Warrior!

The Emperor has returned! After the Shane Gang failed to defeat the Iron Warrior, the Emperor sets to work creating even more Unstoppable Warriors to reclaim the Eastern Caverns. The Shane Gang search for a way to defeat the new creations, but when the Emperor places a bounty on Junjie's head, they also have to deal with the Dai-Fu and hordes of the Emperor's Underlords.

programmes.st: The Return of the Eastern Champion
programmes.d: Junjie, Eli and the Gang rally their friends and even some old enemies-to help them take down the Emperor.

The Shane Gang return home to the 99 caverns to find Gateway Cavern overrun with slugs-in Eli's absence, the Shadow Clan have governed by putting the slugs before the people, and the result is chaos! It's up to Eli to restore the balance, but the Shadow Clan aren't as friendly as they once were...and that's saying something. Help comes from an unexpected source-Tad and his slug Pieper, who just arrived from the Surface!

The Shane Gang take Tad under their wing, training him to blast like a pro with Eli's old blaster and teaching him to live by the slugslinger's code. Tad takes to it like a natural, and as Kord says, it looks like they have another "slugslinging savant from the Surface" on their hands. But their training will be put to the test when Tad accompanies them to a showdown with the Scrap Force...and the Shadow Clan!

Tad is still missing after the slug-out with the Shadow Clan, but the Gang have to set off without him when reports start coming in of slugs disappearing all across the 99 caverns. As they pursue the trail of missing slugs, the mystery grows darker when it leads them straight to Dr. Blakk's old stronghold!

Tad's hypnotic slug Pieper has gone megamorph, his gang of supporters all have Gattler blasters, and Tad's control over his army of ghouls is stronger than Dr. Blakk's ever was. The Shane Gang are under non-stop ghoul fire as they struggle to put a stop to Tad's plans and end the mass ghouling of slugs once and for all.

Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programmes.st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programmes.d: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programmes.st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programmes.d: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programmes.t: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals: Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
programmes.d: Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programmes.st: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
programmes.d: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

programmes.st: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
programmes.d: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programmes.st: Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
programmes.d: Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!

programmes.st: Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
programmes.d: For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd.

programmes.st: Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
programmes.d: Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread  and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!

Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programmes.t: Worth the Hype: BBQ, Pizza, & Noodles in Nashville
programmes.d: Frankie visits Nashville for smoky BBQ Pork, hand-pulled noodles, a luxe burger, and hand-pulled noodles.

Ben Hundreds gets neighborhood goodness at Bonnie's, a truly original Cantonese American concept, mind-blowing plant-based bites and retail at Aunts Et Uncles, and chophouse revival at Gage & Tollner. Plus art galleries, shopping and best pizza.

programmes.st: Taking a Big Bite out of Boston
programmes.d: Ben Hundreds explores heritage-inspired spots in Boston including La Royal, dinner party-inspired Peruvian seafood restaurant, handmade German goodness at Bronwyn and over-the-top tiki culture at Wusong Road  plus the best oysters in town.

programmes.st: Leveling Up in New York City
programmes.d: Ben Hundreds explores cutting edge concepts in NYC including Michelin star-winning Contra and Wildair, Madame Vo, a Vietnamese restaurant inspired by powerful women, and Dhamaka, an explosive Indian eatery. Plus shopping, art and best sandwiches.

programmes.st: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
programmes.d: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programmes.st: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
programmes.d: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programmes.st: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programmes.d: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programmes.st: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programmes.d: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programmes.st: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh

programmes.d: Roger asks Doug to take care of his cat, Stinky, while he goes on a trip. Someone has sabotaged the wheelbarrow race at the Bluffington picnic and Doug and Pattie team up to solve the mystery.

programmes.st: Into The Woods/Krumm Gets The Dreaded Nolox
programmes.d: Ickis has to perform a group scare so he turns to a human he knows for help.   Krumm gets a bad case of hiccoughs known to monsters as The Dreaded Nolox.  It's up to Oblina and Ickis to find a cure.

programmes.st: Mayberry U.F.O. / I Dream of Snorch with the Long Golden Hair
programmes.d: Heavy rains wash Ickis, Krumm and Oblina through the sewer and into a backwards rural town.  They are mistaken for aliens and must escape from the rural mob.   On a dare inspired by Oblina, Ickis and Krumm steal the Snorch's prized golden nosehair.
On a beautiful spring day, Ickis, Krumm and Oblina frolic in a fresh pile of garbage only to find that they have inadvertently boarded a garbage barge headed for the wide open seas.

Daggett and Norbert vie for their baby sister's affection when the two girls are left in their care for the weekend. While self-proclaimed child care guru Dag maps out an itinerary of Fun things to do, Norb allows them to do what they want.

A monster storm washes the Beavers out of their dam and strands them in a scary Dixieland bayou. At first, Norbert dismisses Daggett's fears about the swamp, but soon the two are running for their lives.

When the Thornberrys leave Australia,  Eliza can't bear to leave her wambat friend, Emily. Even though Eliza is told not to, she brings Emily aboard their ship bound to India. To ensure her survival, Eliza must constantly re-create Emily's habitat.
With the commvee broken down in the desert and no water left to survive, the Thornberrys go through desperate measures to maintain their sanity.

Susie coaches Harold to help him get a date with Angelica. He soon becomes the most popular boy in school. Meanwhile, Dil tries to play Cupid himself as he helps Vice-Principal Pangborn woo Miss O'Keats.
Angelica falls for Darryl and gets stuck on a sailboat with her mom the day of his rock concert. Meanwhile, Tommy invites Rachel to dinner but he's afraid she might not like his family.

Tommy goes to Hebrew school to prepare for his bar mitzvah, where he meets Rachel. Tommy is instantly smitten. He goes a little overboard to impress her. Will she forgive him when she finds out that he lied to her?

Tommy is annoyed by Dil's eccentric behavior and needs some space. When the gang visits the Cirque Extravaganza Day Camp, Dil meets a whole group of kids just like him. They invite him to join their troupe. Will he choose them over Tommy?
The gang sneaks into a PG-13 movie at the mall and Angelica catches them. Angelica can't wait to blackmail the other kids. But then the mall closes, locking them inside with two bumbling robbers.

Angelica stays with Susie's family for a week because her mom thinks she needs more discipline. The gang starts placing bets whether or not Angelica can handle the Carmichael family rules all week, but can she make it?
Phil falls for the captain of the school soccer team. Meanwhile, Vice-Principal Pangborn asks Dil, Tommy, and Chuckie to hang around with his nephew, who turns out to be irritating and annoying.

BTR is too famous to be living at the Palm Woods, so Gustavo moves them to Bel Air. However the rules that come with upscale living don’t agree with the guys and they plot their grand escape back to the Palm Woods.

Its date night at the Palm Woods. James helps Carlos on his date with one of the Jennifers, Kendall joins Lucy’s dinner with her parents, and Logan takes a blind date out so he can spy on Camille's date with Jett.

Griffin is pitching a line of BTR merchandise to the CEO of Selmart, but the boys hate the products. Taking matters into their own hands the guys crash the meeting and accidently get their music banned from Selmart stores.
Kendall and Lucy are about to have their first kiss when her good looking ex-boyfriend Beau shows up to win her back. Griffin recruits Logan and Carlos to help him prepare for corporate espionage.
Kendall is ready to ask out Lucy, but Jo unexpectedly shows up and Kendall has to decide which girl is the one for him. Meanwhile Carlos and James’ friendship is put to the test.

Kendall and Logan must take care of Rocque Records' newest artist – an out-of-it rock legend until his induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame that night. James and Carlos are stuck babysitting Katie.

The guys want to go camping, but Gustavo nixes the idea because it’s dangerous. Instead they use their connections to camp on a sound stage, but things go awry as the guys try to show off their roughing it skills.
It's Science Fair time and Josh is sure that this year, his is the project to beat. But when Mindy Crenshaw makes a surprise return, sparks fly in the most unexpected places.

When Drake and Josh mistakenly assume that Walter's suspicious behavior means that he is having an affair, they decide to take matters into their own hands, but ultimately end up cheating only themselves.
Fueled by a love of the opposite sex and fear of commitment, Drake breaks up with his girlfriend only to realize that he may have made the wrong decision.

Helen enlists the aide of Drake and Josh after laser eye surgery leaves her temporarily blinded.  When they lose Helen after taking advantage of her many at-home amenities, they are forced to ask themselves, who's the blind one in this situation?
After a botched weightlifting routine, Josh injures his toe and is forced to the hospital. Drake wants nothing to do with this until a bodacious young nurse catches his eye.
A six-year-old argument between Drake and Josh is suddenly rekindled when their conflicting accounts of a incident at a San Diego Padres game finds them each placing the blame on the other.
A 15-year-old fashion maven is tapped to head up the youth division of a major fashion label. There, she soon learns the corporate world is similar to high school.
When the head of the biggest retail chain in Iceland comes to visit Mad Style, Amanda and True compete to see whose design gets to be featured there.
When Lulu screws up one of True's projects, True has to decide whether to keep her as her assistant or give her the boot.
True is forced to babysit a very high-maintenance model.
Roger is planning a surprise anniversary party for Sheryl. Too bad Kenan and Kel are in charge of picking up the cake and Sheryl's gift.
There's a rat loose in Rigby's.  It's up to Kenan and Kel to capture it before the exterminator gets to the rat.
As a result of bumbling, Kenan and Kel find themselves trapped in a freezer.  Oh, they're also trapped in there with Roger, Sheryl, Kyra, a restaurant full of customers and Dr. Joyce Brothers.
Eager to see the gifts his parents brought him for his birthday, Kenan snoops around and ultimately finds it.

Chris entrusts Kenan and Kel with the responsibility of taking care of his house while he's out of town.  The guys do a great job, if you don't count the fire, and the flood, and the hole in the ceiling, and the...

Kendall and Logan volunteer at a dog shelter and end up adopting 12 dogs, but a sneaky heath inspector is on to them. Carlos and Jennifer’s puppy love is sickening and it’s up to James and the other Jennifers to rescue them.

Kendall buys Jo a gold necklace to show that he’s committed, but Camille thinks Logan bought it for her. Gustavo hangs BTR’s new gold record and Carlos and James wonder what would happen if they played it.

The guys accidentally destroy the tape of the new Big Time Rush episode they were supposed to give the network. Needing a replacement episode the guys decide to make a blooper show which Stephen Glickman and Ciara Bravo host.

Big Time Invasion: BTR has to stop the invasion of the British boy band! Concerned that Gustavo is spread too thin, the boys try to hire a top music manager. Unable to agree, the four split and a rift quickly escalates within the band.
Drake's new girlfriend might be tougher than him.  Josh trying to impress Mindy's parents might be even tougher.  Will the boys prevail, or will girl power rule the day?
When Drake and Josh find out Megan have adopted a pet sheep, they want nothing to do with it.
Josh gets a student teaching job in Miranda's classroom, and Drake potentially discovers his new drummer.

programmes.d: The comic "Bluntman and Chronic" is adapted for the big-screen by Hollywood without the permission of the real-life stoner icons of CLERKS— Jay and Silent Bob.

The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.
Two loafers who spend way too much time at the mall try to win back their girlfriends with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay.

Cult comic-book artist Holden falls head-over-heels with fellow artist Alyssa, but, for that love to live, he'll need to contend with his disapproving best friend Banky, her sexuality, and his own misgivings about himself in this Kevin Smith classic.

The crew is hired to rescue a princess from a notorious outlaw, but it is soon revealed that she was trying to escape murder at her father's hand.
The Collectors now control the Commonwealth and put the Andromeda crew on trial.
Andromeda discovers a shipment of bio-armor, with terrifying results.

programmes.st: The Warmth of an Invisible Light
programmes.d: An experimental cloaking device drops Dylan in an alternate universe, where he learns how to save the Andromeda - assuming he can get back to his own reality.
The Andromeda gets caught in a war between two ships that includes a fatal disease - one that Dylan picks up.
Dylan is tricked by Rev and kidnapped. The crew finds an "unexpected ally" in a Collector.

programmes.st: Lost in a Space That Isn't There
programmes.d: The Abyss has infected Beka. The crew must find a way to save her.
After some of the crew is captured, Harper is forced to work on a time bridge for the Patriarch.
A spy from Tri Gemma shows up on the Andromeda in an attempt to steal the Star Map.
When Rommie becomes too emotional, the ship cuts her access in order to run diagnostics. This leaves the ship vulnerable to a Magog attack.
The Abyss kills Beka's friend, and the crew must figure out what information they killed for.
Andromeda rescues a ship returning from peace talks with the Magog. An attack is coming.
The Magog attack has dire consequences. The Andromeda is destroyed, Trance and Dylan are presumed the only survivors, and Dylan escapes into the Route of Ages.
Dylan ends up on Seefra, where the superstitious population has no technology. Rhade is there, none too happy to see Dylan.
Beka is dumped on Seefra after the Andromeda is stolen, and Dylan must prove the ship is his.
Still, on Seefra, Dylan finds Harper, who has adjusted to life there, and the mysterious Doyle.
It turns out Doyle is an android, built by Harper to contain Rommie's core programming. During a battle with androids from the future, a way out of Seefra is destroyed.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Wheel of Fortune
programmes.d: Jotaro and his group head toward Pakistan by car. Polnareff is behind the wheel on a dangerous mountain road when a mysterious vehicle starts impeding their progress.
After surviving another attack, Jotaro and his team make it to Pakistan, where they stop at an inn to rest. The village around the inn, however, is quiet, and its inhabitants rather odd.
Polnareff realizes that Enyaba is a new assassin sent by DIO. He is prevented from warning his comrades by Enyaba's Stand "Justice," which has the ability to control corpses.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 1
programmes.d: After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Dan of Steel.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 2
programmes.d: Dan of Steel's Stand, "The Lovers," has entered Joseph's brain. With Joseph's life on the line, Jotaro has no choice but to carry out Dan's orders, but the rest of his companions have their own say in the matter.
Jotaro and his fellows take camels and travel across the desert, headed for Cairo. Along the way, though, they can't shake the sensation that someone or something is watching their every move.

Kakyoin dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream he witnesses Death cut down a dog, but after waking up in terror he can't remember what the nightmare was about.
Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is a Stand user, but they merely start to doubt his sanity. Unable to persuade his friends, Kakyoin resorts to some extreme measures.
Jotaro and the team visit an island in the Red Sea and find Avdol's father, renewing the grief Polnareff felt over his friend's death. But perhaps there is a way he can right that wrong. Or not.
Polnareff revives his sister Shelly using one of his three wishes but is then attacked by her. The enemy Stand user, Cameo, then says he'll grant Polnareff's last wish and revives Avdol.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of transport, but as they travel through the Red Sea they realize that there are few places to escape to should danger arise underwater.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 2
programmes.d: The team attempts to escape the submarine with scuba gear as it sinks under attacks from the shape-changing enemy Stand "High Priestess."

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programmes.st: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and his friends finally land in Egypt, where DIO awaits, and are cutting through the desert when a helicopter approaches. The helicopter belongs to the Speedwagon Foundation and is there to make a special delivery requested by Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programmes.st: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programmes.d: Jotaro and crew acquire the help of Iggy but are ambushed by a water Stand. With Kakyoin injured, Avdol tries out a stratagem which the unseen enemy quickly sees through. Meanwhile, Iggy is napping.
Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains, and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.
Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association, Hellish Blizzard issues an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master’s stalker.
Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S-Class hero 'Tanktop Master.'
Metal Bat guards some VIPs while Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.
Absorbing Kaname’s blood finally revives Rido. The vampires all suspect this, and an unsettled mood enshrouds the Academy.
In order to protect the academy, the Headmaster confronts the head of the Hunter Society while Rido is still on the rampage.
Yuki decides that as Guardian, she must protect all the students at the academy and fight Rido.
All of Zero’s strength is not enough to kill Rido, and Rido runs away. However, Kaname finds Rido, and Zero arrives soon after.
Near, along with the SPK, meets Light and the task force at a warehouse for the final showdown.
Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive.
Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hand, the power of the Death Note.
While the world's criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations.
Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail.
Light, now known to the world as Kira, tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways.
Ibara and the other passengers rejoice after their train has successfully escaped from the Zone.
Three girls, Ibara Naruse, Aoi Fukasaku, and Taeko Nomura, arrive in the ruins of the Old Capital, which was destroyed in an accident decades ago.
The girls encounter a couple named Mitsuo and Yukiko who are searching for their missing daughter Miku.
Vice Principal Mishima learns from the rescued Tanizaki about a man known as the Delivery Man believed to be their leader.
The Coppelion succeed in bringing down the monster crow, which then crash-lands in one of the Zones.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 3
programmes.d: While Angus Ashworth strips off for an unlikely history lesson, Steven Moore tucks into a local delicacy. Will a rough ferry crossing leave them feeling sick at the Clitheroe auction?

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 4
programmes.d: Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth hit the byways of Derbyshire and Yorkshire. They visit a couple of survivors from the Industrial Revolution and enjoy some regional pastries before heading off to an auction in the town of Bedale.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and Steven Moore, Day 5
programmes.d: Experts Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth browse the emporiums of northeast England, parting with their big budget. But who will be victorious at the deciding auction in Dundee?

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 1
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper sightsee around Northern Ireland in an old VW Beetle, on the lookout for an antique bargain. David visits the oldest distillery in the world, and Louise heads to the coast to sample some seaweed.

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 2
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper continue their adventures in Northern Ireland. David gets a shock when he gets his hands on a Victorian cure-all, while Louise finds an ally while shopping.

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 3
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper hit the shops in the northwest of England in their classic VW Beetle, keeping an eye out for items of interest, including some KGB spy equipment.

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 4
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper are in Wales, where Louise hopes to be sitting pretty with her collection of chairs, and David tries to step out of his comfort zone.

programmes.st: Louise Gostelow and David Harper, Day 5
programmes.d: Louise Gostelow and David Harper begin their last day on the moors of West Yorkshire. Louise gets her hands on a very early labor-saving device, and David takes a shine to some theatre seats, but how many he can afford?

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Raj Bisram, Day 1
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin Sharp splurges on an expensive French sunburst clock, and a Victorian scent bottle has her swooning. But former soldier Raj Bisram finds ammunition boxes and a steel helmet a lot more attractive.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Raj Bisram, Day 2
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Raj Bisram continue their rally through East Anglia in the 1960s Sunbeam Rapier. Raj does a spot of 'step dancing' in a local pub, while Natasha buys a jukebox from the 1800s.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Raj Bisram, Day 3

After confronting Charmaine at Phor's concert and learning the truth about Charmaine and Don, Ashley makes a shocking decision about their relationship. Presented by VH1.

The crew heads to Orlando for Black Ink boot camp where Ceaser is ready to see who is really there for Black Ink. Everyone gets put to the test as tensions arise when Bux and Spyder air their unfinished business at dinner.

The crew is left in disarray after the bar fight. Ceaser and the bosses wonder what this means for the future of Black Ink, while Rok and Krystal's plans to open a Black Ink New Jersey come to a screeching halt.
While Ted and Puma address the fallout from Orlando, Tatti starts her new life post Black Ink. Bae attempts to make amends with Krystal as Rok decides whether he's more loyal to Krystal or Black Ink.

When a knife-wielding attacker dressed as Baron Samedi, the Spirit of Death, stabs a man in costume on Halloween, Danny enters the world of voodoo.
Danny arrives at a college campus to find a murdered student, who was thought to be dealing drugs.
When two motorists driving gas-guzzling cars die at the hands of a sniper, Danny and Kate are put on the case of what the city believes is the work of a radical environmental serial killer.
When Danny and Kate come up empty-handed with leads for a shooting, Linda helps make a break in the case when she overhears the victim telling his priest who is responsible.
Jamie must deal with the emotional consequences of his actions on the job.
When Danny's car matches an NYPD description of a vehicle involved in a drug deal, he is stopped and taken into custody when a bag of cocaine is found in his trunk.
When a man with multiple rat bites is thrown from a moving car, Danny works the case to find out why and who was trying to send a message.

Before a Hasidic Grand Rebbe passes away, he chooses his youngest son to succeed him. But when the new appointee dies suddenly, Danny investigates the oldest son and others within the Hasidic community.
When a 10-year-old boy is the victim of an incident in the projects, Danny's heated approach to the case lands him in anger management class.
Erin and Danny investigate a cold case of a girl who was attacked by her rich and powerful boyfriend, who was never convicted.
When an off-duty cop tries to stop a bank robbery, he is disarmed by the 'Bonnie and Clyde' robbers who take his gun and wound an innocent bystander.
When the same tragedy occurs to people who don't appear connected, Danny must find what they have in common and who is responsible.
When a religious young woman is murdered, Danny questions her family who is shocked to learn that she had a secret relationship.
When two Wall Street brokers are killed in drug deals, Danny looks to question a wounded accomplice at the hospital but he is stopped by Linda, who won't let Danny see him until after surgery.

When Danny finds a disoriented man in a park covered in his girlfriend's blood, he finds it hard to believe that the man has no recollection of the night's events until they find a strong narcotic in his bloodstream.
When a young woman commits suicide, Danny is emotional since he promised to help her when her parents were taken from her.
As the Reagans rally together to take down the leader of the gang responsible for the murder of someone close to them, Danny looks to the gang leader's girlfriend to lead them to him.
A mule skinner and his two sons are hired by Ben to transport nitroglycerin to California.
Joe struggles to understand whether his friend was right in killing a dying man who pleaded to put out of his misery.
No one in Virginia City is happy to see ex-con Trace Cordell, especially the man he crippled in a gunfight, now married to Cordell's former girlfriend.
Ben becomes irritable and reckless when the completion of an important timber contract is hindered by an old rival.
Adam takes a shine to Rebecca Kaufman, the daughter of a Jewish peddler, and bandits are convinced the Kaufman wagon is worth robbing.
A vain outlaw murders a man in front of witnesses, including Joe, but a clever lawyer is able to get him acquitted.
Adam tries to find the good in Howard Mead, a talented troubadour who refuses to stay on the right side of the law.
Adam sets out to track down the man who has been impersonating him to clear his reputation.
Joe teaches Johnny Chapman how to use a gun for defense.  What Joe doesn't see is the deadly consequences that it has in the long run when Johnny becomes a gunfighter.

Kellie Conrad dances and her father plays the fiddle to earn a living.  Hoss feels a sense of guilt after he unintentionally hurts the arm that Kellie's father uses to play the fiddle, in a saloon fight with some roughnecks.
One of Joe's old girlfriends thinks he killed her husband so they could come together.  Unfortunately, that is what her husband's twin brother also believes.

The Cartwrights are visited by their second cousin, Muley Jones of Weedville, Missouri who sings with a window-shattering voice and stirs up trouble with Indian negotiations that Ben is trying to ensure.

A judge awards itinerant horse breeder Jim Acton's beloved mare to rancher Sam Whipple. Jim tries to buy her back, but Whipple refuses his offer, after which a fight ensues and Jim kills Whipple in self-defense.

When Cochise falls on Joe, Ben cannot help but remember that is how Marie Cartwright was killed.  He thinks back to meeting her in New Orleans in a rather confusing story not quite in synch with details discussed in "The First Born".
Hoss finds himself in another mess, this one involving a beautiful blonde, a moonshiner, and a nearsighted outlaw who is allergic to chocolate and flowers.
After his only friend is killed, the Cartwrights take in a slow-witted man, who Roy Coffee informs them, is wanted for murder by Arizona authorities.

For a change, it is Adam rather than Joe who becomes mixed up in one of Hoss' funny exploits. Together they purchase a thoroughbred horse, and end up competing against their little brother in the big Virginia City race.
As Boruto and his friends finish their battle with Ao, Koji Kashin, a member of Kara, appears!
On their way back to the village, the team discovers an unconscious boy who has the same strange mark on his palm as Boruto.
The battle between Garo—an Outer—and Kawaki—also known as the Vessel—begins!
The team returns to the Advanced Technology Lab with Kawaki. Konohamaru has returned to the village to report on the mission.
Kawaki escapes the Advanced Technology Lab and finds himself in a bustling shopping district. Exhausted and hungry, he desperately searches for food.
Kawaki collapses and is tormented by nightmares from his childhood.
The Five Kage agree to place Kawaki under Naruto’s custody. Naruto takes Kawaki home, but the atmosphere between Boruto and Kawaki turns threatening.
Boruto is furious that Kawaki has broken a vase that his little sister had made for their mother, fanning the flames between them. As a fellow wielder of the Karma, Kawaki makes a proposal.
Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada.
Kawaki watches a Shinobi Hand-to-Hand Combat match between Naruto and Boruto. Boruto uses his specialty, the Shadow Clone Jutsu, to take on his father, but he struggles.
In order to get a better handle on their Karmas, Boruto and Kawaki decide to train under more realistic conditions.
Delta forces her way into the Leaf Village to take Kawaki back and appears before Boruto and the others. In response, Naruto unleashes the power of the Nine Tails, and a fierce clash ensues!
Delta uses her destructive beam that can neutralize any regenerative power. Undaunted, Naruto forcefully suppresses it with a Giant Rasengan.
Delta informs Jigen that Boruto also has a Karma on his palm. Upon hearing this, Jigen smiles…
As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him.
Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan.
A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!
Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu.
With the enemy's sudden appearance, Naruto, the Seventh Hokage and leader of the village, has vanished.
Boruto and the others attack Boro to save Naruto, but Boro drives them back by releasing a mysterious dark mist that paralyses his opponents.
The newly formed Team 7's all-out attack damages Boro, and their efforts seem to be successful. However, Boro uses his regenerative powers to revive himself.
Despite sustaining serious damage from the new Team 7, Boro goes on a mad rampage, threatening Boruto and the others with total annihilation.
Kawaki begins to worry that his presence puts Hidden Leaf Village at risk, especially since Kara is after him.
In order to learn more about Boro’s connection to Kara, Konohamaru and Sai are tasked with a mission to infiltrate Boro's cult.
Someone has stolen data about the Leaf Ninja, and it’s suspected a spy may have been planted inside the village.
Amado, a principal member of Kara who oversaw their research and development, kidnaps Shikadai and seeks asylum in the Leaf Village.
In exchange for being granted asylum in the Village Hidden in the Leaves, Amado reveals everything he knows.
The battle between Koji Kashin and Jigen begins at Kara’s hideout.

A young girl is abducted from outside a convenience store, triggering an Amber alert.
A woman is found dead in a hotel suite with symptoms of the ebola virus.
Grissom and Sara investigate the murder of a woman after a swap party where the married couples in the neighborhood meet and switch partners.
Grissom is called to a murder of a 17-year-old in a casino penthouse. The entire team gets involved when its discovered that a kidnapping took place along with the murder.
The killer from The Execution of Catherine Willows returns with deadly results.
A woman who was pulled over by the police is found murdered two miles up the road from the stop. It's not long before Robbins determines that the woman is, genetically speaking, not a woman.
Grissom is confronted with new evidence while on the stand of a murder trial of a restaurant owner.
Grissom and his team investigate the starving death of a five-year-old boy. They discover the boy has siblings who are in danger too.
Greg, for his final proficiency, has to determine how the Sherlock Holmes of a Sherlock Holmes club was killed.
Warrick looks into the murder of a man by someone who apparently needs a wheelchair. Nick looks into the murder of a woman in the subculture of the narcocorrido, songs about drug murders.
Catherine, Warrick, and Nick find the body of two women at a construction site buried under tar. The swing shift is brought into the world of foreign mail-order brides.
Grissom, Sofia, Sara, and Greg investigate the disappearance of a woman coming home from a night out with a friend after her abandoned car is found on the edge of a highway.
A routine traffic stop ends in the murder of a patrolman. The CSI team must sort out a young girl's obsessive love affair in order to find the killer.
A "Friction Party" at a private suite in one of the city's hotels accommodating hundreds of cruise passengers leaves a young woman dead.
Horatio faces a former nemesis who escaped his grasp once before, a case of stolen identity leads to murder, the question becomes "which one did it?"

Tax season gets off to a bang when two IRS agents turn up dead.  Horatio Caine and the CSI Team are called in to investigate.
South Beach Miami’s sexiest nightclub becomes a hotbed of revenge when murder closes the doors on a unique dating service.

The CSI team races against time to locate and deactivate a radioactive bomb set to go off in the middle of downtown Miami.

A free street concert quickly turns into a crime scene, the victim, in this case, has been mysteriously plagued with radiation.
Mac is traveling to Washington to testify in court until he realizes he’s in the vicinity of a murder when a stewardess finds a dead body.
A very powerful woman in the world of politics is found dead leaving many desperate in hoping that her information does not get leaked out.
The CSIs investigate the death of a young archaeologist who may have unearthed the answer to one of New York City's oldest murder mysteries.
When three defendants are gunned down on the eve of their trial, Mac is forced to make good on a promise he made to a reluctant witness.
Investigation of a floating crime scene leads the team into the world of SecretU an art-house world of true confessionals.
When two men who share the same name as detective Mac Taylor are killed, detective Taylor rounds up all the other Mac Taylors in New York and tries to figure out who will be the next victim.
The remains of a pregnant 17-year-old are found in the trunk of a crashed car, but the baby is missing. During the investigation, Danny finds out some shocking news about Lindsay.
The CSIs are forced to investigate two crimes at once with a mysterious energy field near The Empire State Building at the center of both.
The CSIs appear to have an open and shut case after a murder suspect is impaled during a police pursuit, but it turns out to only be beginning.
Young brides-to-be fight over a killer dress at the biggest wedding gown sale of the year and one of the shoppers winds up dead.
The CSIs must piece together a human jigsaw puzzle when a beloved wrestling coach's severed body parts are found buried throughout the city.
A Russian tourist is found stabbed to death and the CSIs come face to face with the frightening realities of human trafficking.
When the Mayor's dead body falls from the ceiling at a charity fundraiser, Stella and her date find themselves in the middle of the crime scene.
When a buzzard flying over Manhattan drops a human eyeball from its claw, the race is on to find the body it belongs to.
