programmes.d: Piper and Paige team up with a magical Wizard to stop the coronation of a new Source, not realizing that the new head of the Underworld is Cole and Phoebe is his Evil Queen-to-be.
Phoebe is irritated with the lack of attention of Cole and destroys five of his demons in a couple of days.
Phoebe's unborn baby begins to show signs of demonic powers as it begins to take control of her body and attack Paige and anyone else who might be a threat to it.
While Phoebe feels Cole trying to contact her, the Angel of Destiny comes to the Halliwell manor and proposes to remove the powers of the sisters as a reward for vanquishing The Source.
Piper, Phoebe and Paige come to the aid of Mylie, a Mermaid-turned-human, when she shows up looking for their help after a pact she made with an evil Sea Hag begins to go drastically wrong.

An evil witch traps the Halliwell sisters in distorted versions of classic fairy tales, where Phoebe attends a ball as Cinderella, Paige has a taste of Snow White's poisoned apple, and Piper encounters a big, bad wolf, as Little Red Riding Hood.

Cole and Phoebe both fall under the spell of the Siren, who lures husbands to her and entrances their wives to follow with the intent to kill, leaving Piper and Paige to figure out how to save Phoebe.

When a demon coerces a boy into turning him into an evil comic book villain so he can steal an Elder's powers, the boy transforms The Charmed Ones into comic book heroes with superhuman strengths to prevent this from happening.

While seeking the advice of a fortune teller regarding her missing powers, Phoebe discovers in a premonition that a demon is going to kill them all after murdering the last one of the coven they were supposed to protect.
Barbas, the Demon of Fear, returns and tricks Paige into giving him Cole's powers, and plots revenge on the Halliwell sisters by playing them against their darkest fears.
When Phoebe must constantly save the life of her new boyfriend, a warlock shows up from the future, claiming that future Cole sent him in order to kill the boyfriend before Phoebe dies instead.

Paige gets to know the whitelighter in her, when she meets her first charge, a man named Sam. Unbeknownst to her, Sam is actually her real father. Meanwhile, Cole rashly tries to get himself vanquished by the Charmed Ones.

Phoebe falls prey to Jeric, a demon in search of the perfect body to hold the spirit of Isis, his dead lover. To trap the spirit, Jeric mummifies Phoebe's body. Meanwhile, Cole tries to save Phoebe by making a deal with the demon.

After kidnapping Phoebe, Cole sends a shapeshifter to assume Phoebe's identity to help him manipulate Piper and Paige into giving him ownership of the manor, allowing him access to the powerful Nexus located beneath the house.
In his twisted attempt to win Phoebe's heart back, Cole casts a spell that alters reality, which eliminates Paige as a Halliwell and destroys the Power of Three.

Glen returns to Paige's life with a big surprise - he is about to get married to a girl called Jessica. Meanwhile, the sisters summon a Witch Doctor whom they want to dispatch all the evil remnants that surround the Manor.
Sam, Carla and Norm set sail in Robin Colcord's boat, only to discover there's a live bomb on board.
While the bar's patrons and management celebrate Cheers' 100-year anniversary, Lilith gives birth to a baby boy.

programmes.st: Death Takes A Holiday On Ice
programmes.d: Following Eddie's untimely death, Carla discovers her husband was two-timing her when she meets his other wife at the funeral.
Frasier kidnaps his own son to keep him from being ritually circumcised in the Jewish tradition.
The guys at Cheers have a beard-growing contest to test their manhood.
When Rebecca's plan to surprise Robin Colcord with a romantic evening backfires, she ends up trapped in Robin's penthouse with Sam.
While Norm's ex-secretary falls for Cliff, Rebecca searches for "hidden treasure" in a gift from Robin.
Rebecca's favorite college professor comes to visit, and much to her disbelief, has a brief affair with Sam.
Cliff gets hauled off the stage when he's a contestant on Jeopardy.
Rebecca finds out that she's not the only woman in Robin's love life.
Rebecca finds out that she's not the only woman in Robin's love life.
Woody's girlfriend's mother, a beautiful older woman, makes sexual advances toward him.
Frasier is upset when Lilith's new book labels him a boring, dependable "good boy."

programmes.st: Indoor Fun With Sammy And Robby
programmes.d: Rebecca's plans for a romantic day with Robin are ruined when he opts to spend the day in a game of one-upmanship with Sam.
Carla is consumed with guilt when she hides the money from her late husband's estate from his other widow.

programmes.st: Bar Wars III: Return Of Tecumseh
programmes.d: Then the gang notices that the bar's wooden statue of Tecumseh is missing. Their rival Gary is the suspected culprit.
Woody gives Kelly a promise ring when her father arranges for her to go to Europe.
Carla fears Eddie's ghost is haunting her when she decides to begin dating again.
Sam believes he's finally tricked Rebecca into spending the night with him, but ultimately learns the joke is on him.
After Robin asks Rebecca to move in with him, she learns he's been using her to plan a hostile takeover of her corporation.
Sam regains ownership of the bar, as well as a long-awaited chance with Rebecca, when he turns Robin over to the authorities for insider trading.

programmes.st: Love Is A Really, Really Perfectly Okay Thing
programmes.d: Robin unexpectedly returns after running out on Rebecca and the law.
Kevin McHale joins the Cheers gang in a basketball game against their rival bar.
Sam tries to get Rebecca back at Cheers after she takes another job.
Rebecca's miffed when Robin's ex tells the press that she's his true love.
Woody lets Ma Clavin move into Woody's apartment, much to Cliff's chagrin.
Norm fights to save his favorite hangout from getting demolished.

programmes.st: Breaking In Is Hard To Do
programmes.d: Rebecca plans a surprise visit to her prison bound love, Robin.
In this very special celebration of "Cheers"' 200th show, Shelley Long rejoins the rest of the gang for a unique look back at the past eight years in part one of a two-part episode.
In this very special celebration of "Cheers"' 200th show, Shelley Long rejoins the rest of the gang for a unique look back at the past eight years in part two of a two-part episode.
Sam loses his cool when a restaurateur takes over the poolroom and restrooms.
Woody promotes a horrible vegetable drink on his first commercial appearance.
Cliff and Norm's practical joking put Sam and Frasier at odds with each other.
Buddy and Duff face off with cakes depicting a bug's world.
Buddy and Duff try to out-do each other with their pirate cakes.
Buddy and Duff face off in an architecture challenge.
For the competition finale, Buddy and Duff create monster cakes.
Twenty-four of the country's worst home cooks come to New York City.
The recruits learn fundamental knife skills at Arirang Hibachi Steakhouse.
The chefs illustrate the importance of flavor with a "blank canvas."
The chefs teach their teams about the importance of multitasking.
Each chef teaches their two recruits a complicated dessert.
The remaining two recruits prepare a three-course meal for food critics.
Out of hundreds of hopefuls, 16 terrible cooks head to culinary boot camp.
The recruits take a field trip to a farm to prepare the perfect omelet.
The recruits must replicate a frozen meal makeover using fresh ingredients.
Each recruit must cook a meal, eat it with his or her chef and defend it.
The recruits cater a party for NFL star Kris Jenkins and 30 of his guests.
The remaining six recruits attempt to conquer intimidating ingredients.
The final four compete in a "Culinary Decathlon" Skill Drill.
The final recruits must create a three-course meal for a panel of judges.
Sixteen of the country's worst home cooks try to "impress" Anne and Bobby.
The recruits learn to make hand-pulled Chinese noodles and meatballs.
The team updates a cabin for the original builder's great-granddaughter.

programmes.st: Teaching an Old Cabin New Tricks
programmes.d: Chase and the team expand a cabin to accommodate the next generation.
Chase and the team have their hands full restoring an isolated cabin.
The team opens up the floor plan of a cabin in Greenville Junction, Maine.
The team takes on a project of helping a camp for underprivileged kids.
Chase and the team are put to the test to restore a 1900s cabin.
The team updates a camp to take it out of its outdated decor.
Chase and the team expand the footprint of a family's cramped cabin.
Chase and the team make several repairs to a family's Belgrade cabin.

programmes.st: A Home for the Cabin Masters
programmes.d: The team transforms a 100-year-old farmhouse into their new headquarters.
A couple wants to see their camping cabin turned into a vacation retreat.
Chase and his team do some serious work on a lakeside family dream home.
Chase and the team finish a cabin started by an outdoor enthusiast couple.

programmes.st: A Cabin For the Whole Family
programmes.d: The Cabin Masters repair and renovate a family cabin in Pickerel Pond, ME.
The team must navigate a treacherous hillside to repair a family's cabin.
Chase and the team upgrade an untouched, lakeside cabin in Sidney.
The team reworks a cabin's layout to create more space for a large family.

programmes.st: A Changing of the Guard's Camp
programmes.d: In a show first, the team must tear down a cabin and rebuild from scratch.
The team helps a family with a small cabin that can't house everyone.

programmes.st: Peace, Love and a Fallen Pine Tree
programmes.d: Chase saves a family's camp from a fallen tree and preserves its oddities.
The Cabin Masters give a well-loved camp some much-needed TLC.
A weird inventor, Caractacus Potts, invents an amazing flying car, which drives by itself. It takes him and his Family to Vulgaria, where the sinister buffoon Baron Bomburst kidnaps the car.

A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage Agent. But when the Agent is killed, and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring which is trying to steal top secret information.

It’s handmaiden-to-footservant combat when secretary Barbara Feldon attempts to scuttle butler Dick Van Dyke right out of the heist business in this spirited comedy that also stars John McGiver, Norman Fell, Sam Waterston and Edith Evans.
A columnist and a press agent tear into the maelstrom of midtown Manhattan's night creatures in a sinister game that involves money, power and ultimately survival.

This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).
Gregory Peck heads an all-star cast in this true re-enactment of the terrifying Korean War that brilliantly pulls the viewer inextricably into the crossfire that surrounds American foot soldiers.

programmes.t: The Beast With A Million Eyes
programmes.d: An unspeakable horror! Extraterrestrial terror is on the hunt for human flesh in this horrifying tale of invasion! This is a 1950s creature-feature with some serious sociological bite! Paul Birch, Lorna Thayer, and Richard Sargent star!
In a post-apocalyptic world after an atomic war, seven disparate people find themselves in a protected valley in the home of a survivalist and his beautiful daughter.

In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.
Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.
Archie is jealous when a lonely butcher lavishes attention on Edith.
Maude's investigation into Vivian's erratic behavior reveals a new part of the Harmon's marriage and almost all of Vivian.
Maude's Aunt Lola, who is irresistible to married men -- and vice versa -- zeros in on Mrs. Naugatuck's husband, Bert, as her next conquest.

Arthur's seemingly sudden devotion to a new best friend leaves Walter hurt, angry, and determined to make a new friend of his own. Maude lends a sympathetic ear, but it doesn't help Walter, who feels he has lost his only true friend.
Vivian's pleasure at Arthur's sudden burst of amorous behavior is overcome by panic when it becomes obvious that Arthur is just not himself.

Maude's anger over Mrs. Naugatuck's sudden strange behavior threatens to end their three-year friendship. Maude fires Mrs. Naugatuck, and insists that she leave immediately, until she finds out that she will never see Mrs. Naugatuck again.

Maude is furious when she discovers her wallet is missing after an encounter with a West Indian woman in a New York subway. Her fury turns to rage when the woman suddenly shows up at the Findlay house.
A young runaway wreaks havoc at the Sunshine Cab Co. when Alex and Elaine encourage the lad to return home. Jim wants to adopt him, and Louie wants the youngster jailed for not paying his fare.

Romance and merriment are on the menu for Tony and Alex when they double-date gorgeous twin models at a posh restaurant, only to have the intimate group grow to a crowd with the unwelcome additions of Jim and Alex's ex-wife.
Elaine blows a bundle on the Big Apple's hottest hair stylist for the social bash of the year.
Tony begins working with a new cabbie, Lucius, a former football player. Lucius inspires Tony to try to get his boxing license reinstated.
Felix and Oscar are arrested and charged with ticket scalping.
After burning a hole in Felix's bed, Oscar despairs of raising the money for a new one. But a poker session with his old college friend, Monty Hall, leads to an idea.
When Oscar's mother fears for her son's social life, Felix finds him an-old-fashioned Greek girlfriend.
As a surprise for Oscar, Felix paints the apartment flaming peach, sells the old furniture at a rummage sale and refurnishes the apartment with futuristic pieces.
Mike and Sally argue over the wedding.
Mike and his Air Force Reservist friends collect money for a surgery for a disabled girl.
There's more than their girlfriends at risk if the boys' team loses.
Tramp is scheduled for a film audition in Hollywood.
Rob and Laura unintentionally eavesdrop on the Helpers prior to attending their dinner party.
As director of the annual variety show, Rob finds himself trapped between casting Laura as this year's leading woman or a dazzlingly talented newcomer to the neighborhood.

programmes.st: Who and Where Was Antonio Stradivarius?
programmes.d: Following a concussion at the office, Rob winds up at a swinging party in New Jersey with no idea how he got there.
Rob's energetic Uncle George comes for a visit to eagerly pressure Rob into finding him a wife.
The art dealer buys one of Uncle Joe's paintings for its valuable frame, but Uncle Joe thinks he's on the road to fantastic artistic success.
Betty Jo has her first crush - but the object of her affections (Orville Miggs) is more interested in tinkering with cars than he is in romance.

programmes.st: Behind All Silver, There's A Cloud Lining
programmes.d: Uncle Joe tries to bring more guests to Shady Rest--and get his drainage ditch dug for free--by spreading rumors about a silver strike in the area.
Uncle Joe is promoting a talent contest, and he tries to make sure that one of his three nieces wins.
An old school chum thinks it's time Kate was married again, and she tells the girls to round up some prospects.
Uncle Joe decides to bankrupt the Hooterville Cannonball by starting his own railroad, powered by Orville Miggs' flivver.
Gomer gets his first shot at the obstacle course.
Gomer helps a recruit smuggle his girlfriend into the barracks.
While on a hike Gomer makes a friend, but when the friend decides to move into the barracks Sgt Carter wants him gone! but Gomer shows the sergeant what an asset this new friend is to the platoon.
After tipping his hat instead of saluting female Captain "Iron Pants" Martin, Gomer is assigned special detail in her office to teach him a lesson.
A cop who finds out that he has a terminal illness sets out to kill a racketeer who's been his quarry for the last year and a half.
An operation run by the syndicate is burgled by a small-time crook.
Lieutenant Stone and Inspector Keller go after two insurance agents involved in the counterfeiting of an 1850 6¢ purple Guyana stamp with a value of $300,000.
A controversial television interviewer telephones a shadowy figure named Harry Armitage for the "hot seat" segment of his show, accusing Armitage of bribery and influence peddling.
A young woman who has entered a county fair competition in a rural community north of Los Angeles disappears, and her wealthy father hires Joe Mannix to look for her.
Mannix helps his carnival owner friend find out if any of the workers are causing accidents that might be attempts on her life.
The lovely niece of a Korean War veteran is killed with a blow to her neck, and Mannix looks at evidence that suggests an ex-member of his old army unit murdered her.
Pressure to get good grades at a private high school leads to the death of an instructor. The conspirators try to place the blame first on the victim's drinking and then on the black tennis coach.
After a blow kills his lover's husband, the quick-thinking killer calls police and, pretending to be the victim, lays the blame on two hippies.
What's the perfect heroin-smuggling plot? Hide it in the radiator of a car owned by a tourist above suspicion--Barnaby Jones.
An author whose novels feature his hometown disappears; the publisher hires Barnaby to find the last chapter of the newest novel.

Steve McGarrett's skill and instincts are matched against an impossible crime. Money is stolen from a fortress-like, burglar-proof Honolulu bank built by Matthew Meighan. The impossible has happened, and McGarrett and his Five-O unit are stumped.
Steve investigates a scuba diver's death. A spinster detective novelist, Millicent Shand, claims she solved the mystery and suggests the victim was part of a scheme to swindle fortune from Carole.

Steve warns Dilys of the theft risk, but she scorns him. In Hawaii for vacation, Steve suspects Dilys brought a valuable ruby and tries to protect her, but faces resistance. Can he save her from theft?
Paul Williams as Stringer snaps a picture of a secret meeting of racketeer Alika and influence peddler Kramer. Paul uses this evidence to extort Kramer, putting himself in danger from Alika.

Steve McGarrett chases after ex-cop, now private detective, Russ Hendrix, whom he admires but suspects of killing Honolulu pimps. Hendrix knows McGarrett is onto him, making the pursuit dangerous. Will McGarrett bring the murderer to justice?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: While singing at her boyfriend Troy’s nightclub, LuAnn Corbin discovers that he is being forced by a shady drug dealer from his past, Brent Shaw, to use the club as a cover to sell Ecstasy. LuAnn is torn between love and her duty as an officer.
Hunter and McCall's kidnapping-homicide investigation is thwarted by a rich industrialist who wants to control their methods of rescuing his abducted wife.

programmes.st: Hunter: S3 E10 - The Cradle Will Rock
programmes.d: McCall masquerades as a nightclub singer to investigate the disappearance of a rock music star.
The malicious leader of a group of paramilitary neo-Nazis take Hunter and McCall captive while planning their next attack.
A cruel collage prank comes back to haunt four young women in later life. Although Amanda had almost forgotten it, a recent letter brings back the unpleasant memory.
Surprise, surprise! While investigating the murder of a call-girl, Dr. Sloan is caught in the middle of a vice raid!

Dr. Sloan becomes involved in more than politics when he accepts an invitation to attend an election campaign party. A face in a crowd of well-wishers awakens old memories for Mayor Ridgeway's wife, Lauren, with murderous results.

A Texas Ranger is killed in the line-of-duty. Two officers apply for the open position. Both are almost equally skilled. One candidate is being hunted by her violent ex-husband, and she thinks about dropping out of the application process.

High school athletes are being coaxed to take a hybrid steroid called Powerballs to enhance their sporting skills. However, the drug takes over their brain and makes them oblivious to danger, causing teems to die from the drug.
The criminal that killed Walker's fiancé ten years ago is being released early from prison. He intends to seek revenge on Walker for putting him away by hurting all of Walker's friends.

LaRue returns. This time, he has a court hearing to determine his sanity. LaRue wrestles a gun from the bailiff and takes over the court, killing people at whim. He is waiting for Walker to come so he can kill Walker.
Kimble hitches a ride with a local clergyman then suddenly, the cleric is killed by a sniper's bullet.
Kimble returns home and visits his sister Donna right under the nose of Gerard.
John McIntire guest stars as a migrant farm worker with whom Richard Kimble is working when he is tracked down and captured by Lt. Gerard.
MacGyver matches wits with a killer who has sprung his buddy from the insane asylum cell they share, in a desperate bid to take revenge on the lady cop who put him away.
MacGyver's old nemesis, Murdoc, uses an unsuspecting Penny Parker as bait in a bizarre plan to lure MacGyver into a trap.
MacGyver learns that Pete Thornton's son, Michael, is involved in an international espionage ring stealing secrets from the Phoenix Foundation.

Always trying to help out a friend, Jack Stewart offers his support when a con-man acquaintance tries to straighten out his life. Instead, Jack's entwined in a mysterious fatal car accident investigation involving a posh health spa.
Steve must escort the daughter of a visiting dignitary.
Robbie decides to take up golfing to impress his father.
Chip's reward for saving a dog makes him popular.
Bub is curious about Steve's top-secret project.
Dennis helps Mr. Wilson sell a neighbor’s house.
When Dennis and Tommy camp out in the backyard, Mr. Wilson suspects wild animals are going to attack them.
Dennis thinks his dad is broke, so he sells bottles in an attempt to make some extra money.
Dennis starts a rumor that he and his family are moving to New York in order to keep Mr. Wilson in town for an award he is due to receive.
When Henry and George mistakenly both cancel their respective sitters, Dennis and another young boy are left alone to wreak havoc.
Mr. Wilson has a bunch of starlings in his tree and wants to get rid of them. Dennis eventually gets rid of the starlings by putting liver in Mr. Wilson’s tree, which attracts a lot of cats.
The Driscolls are new neighbors, but problems arise as their phone is on the same line as the Mitchells.
After hearing that the city is tearing down Mr. Dorfman’s “Postman’s Rest” bench in favor of a parking lot, Dennis and Tommy offer him use of their private bench they plan to build.

While Bill is in Vermont for business, he asks Mr. French and the twins to visit there since it is so pretty. As French drives up, a snowstorm turns into a blizzard and they are forced to take refuge in an abandoned cabin.
Jody is given a bonsai tree by Mr. Osaki. When the tree starts to die as Mr. Osaki gets sick, Jody is worried the tree means Mr. Osaki will die.
A friend of Buffy is deaf, and Uncle Bill asks a friend of his, a doctor who specializes in deaf children, to see if he can do anything for the little girl.
The twins inherit a small amount of money, which to them, seems like riches. They begin to argue about how to spend the money.
Greg works part-time at Mike’s architectural firm.
Jan gets carried away with pulling pranks on her family.
Peter gets a black eye when he tries to defend his little sister.
Bobby suffers from a fear of heights after he falls off a ladder.
An innocent tale about the time the Bradys were invited to spend a Sunday afternoon on Mr. Phillips' boat that is if Cindy and Carol can get over tonsillitis and Carol can keep her big mouth shut!
Jan feels insecure about her freckles when her crush falls for Marcia.
Archie and Edith are shocked when they discover that Stephanie has been stealing some of her favorite teacher's (and the Bunkers') belongings.
After Stephanie comes back from Sunday School, Rev. Chong visits Edith to tell her that even though she is welcome anytime at Sunday School, Stephanie is Jewish. Edith accepts it, unlike Archie.
Barney Hefner is suicidal when Blanche finally deserts him, until Archie fixes him up with an overweight but wealthy widow.

When an ill woman tells Edith to let her die with dignity at the SunShine Home, the woman's family are furious after her death. The manager fires Edith for her selfishness, even though Edith honoured the woman's wish.

Louise Jefferson returns for a visit at the Bunker's place to ask Edith if she can sell her (Louise's) former house. Edith doubts but Archie makes her agree so that they (mostly he) can choose white people to move in.

When Archie's brother, Fred, visits Archie to open up a business, he also brings his 18 year old wife, Katherine. Both, Archie and Edith, and even Stephanie, are shocked as they find out. Archie and Fred argue about Katherine's age.
Stephanie's father, Floyd, finally arrives with a devastating proposition for the Bunkers: They can keep Stephanie if they agree to pay him $1000 cash!

On Archie's St. Patrick's Day Party at the tavern, he discovers that Edith is terribly ill after doing a lot of cooking for him. Sidney comes to the rescue and is able to save Edith before it's too late.
When Mama's dreams start providing the names of winning horses, the family figures they're in the money.
Mama, Iola and Naomi decide to have a chili cook-off with the winner getting her recipe in the church bazaar cookbook. Vint is choosen, against his will, as the judge of the contest.

When Vint and Naomi are having trouble in the bedroom, Mama and Iola soon discover exactly what it is when they turn on Good Morning Raytown, and special guest Dr. Joyce Brothers agrees to take a few phone calls live on-air.

The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

programmes.t: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programmes.d: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programmes.t: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programmes.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.
Documentary exploring the development of music TV over the last 50 years and its power in popularizing the classical genre.
Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's "Goldberg Variations BWV 988" at the Leipzig Bach Festival.

programmes.t: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programmes.d: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programmes.d: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of "Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944" by Franz Schubert.

programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.t: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.
Christoph Eschenbach leads the Orchestre de Paris in the 7th Symphony by Gustav Mahler.

A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programmes.st: Killer on Campus / The Bow Hunter
programmes.d: Thirty-two years after the killing of University of Michigan law student Jane Mixer, police use DNA found on her pantyhose to finally track down the killer.
A boy's toy Batmobile car provides an important clue for detectives struggling to make a case against a serial killer who stalks and kills waitresses.

A 23-year-old teacher vanished the evening before Easter after giving confession. Her body was later found floating in a drainage canal. At the time, a key witness hinted that a member of the Catholic clergy may have been responsible.

A 14-year-old boy is charged with the murder of his sister, but his public defender believes the real killer is still on the loose. And two deteriorated slides, made 16 years earlier, give police the evidence they need to reopen the cold case.

programmes.st: The Flaming Gorge Falls/Caught In The Mail
programmes.d: A man suspected of the cold case murder of his wife and son hatches a new plot to kill his mother and father; and detectives solve the 20-year-old murder of a teenager by tricking her killer into licking an envelope.

When a Nevada couple demands the return of a baby they had sold to another couple, the burned body of the baby turns up in Arizona. Then, a man discovers a barrel in his crawlspace that contains the body of a woman who has been dead for decades.

programmes.st: Mistaken for a Killer/The Boy and the Monster
programmes.d: Advances in DNA technology that take place over 20 years help police to finally identify the man who brutally stabbed two women to death.
In August 1972, the body of Jody Loomis is found in the woods. 34 years later, the killer's DNA is recovered from Jody's old clothing but it isn't matched until 2018.

In Wisconsin, advances in forensic clay modeling help investigators identify a murder victim whose skin was stripped from her head, neck, and legs. And in California, police track down two boys who enjoy satanic rituals and setting fires.
Firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide. A serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit.
Law enforcement officials fear they may have to release a serial killer from prison until a 24-year-old murder case gives them a chance to lock him up for good.
Police in Overland Park, Kansas, hunt for over 15 years for a serial killer who lures women to Kansas for sadomasochistic sexual trysts at hotels.
In July of 1970, the brutal murder of single mom Loretta Jones leaves four-year-old Heidi motherless. Nearly 40 years later, she vows to solve her mother's cold case.
The murder of a 73-year-old man leads police on a long chase for a man who's suspected of identity theft and bears a rose tattoo with the name "Phyllis".

programmes.t: Cold Case Files Classic: Cold Case Files Classics
programmes.d: Best of the Year Marathon: Serial Killers
Lawndale's reputation takes a major hit when an injured Kevin leaves the football team after a motorcycle accident.
Daria dreams up a murder mystery at her school after Kevin and the football team are suspected of cheating on a test.
While trying to be a conformist for an assignment, Jane is selected by the cheerleaders to replace Brittany on the squad.
During Lawndale's homecoming parade, Daria and Tom find themselves reluctantly wrangling a precocious child together.
Ilana visits an old flame to cash out her Bitcoin share; Abbi drops off her laundry for the first time and loses her favorite sweatshirt.
Ilana discovers a terrifying secret about Jaimé; Abbi tries to make the jump from sweater folder to window artist at Anthropologie.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program Ah, Men

NASA astronauts Suni Williams and Leland Melvin have worked on the International Space Station, but need Cesar's help with canine problems.
A couple of German shepherd pups with a shadowy obedience track records; a rescue dog with trust issues.
Cesar Millan investigates the case of a bulldog named Bella who has become aggressive ever since her owner's five-month rehab stint.
A professional dog groomer reaches out to Cesar for help with three of her toughest clients; Cesar helps a couple with their head-strong pit bull.
Puppy mills produce millions of dogs; Caesar works with an animal rights group to rescue and rehabilitate some pups.
Cesar Millan helps Suzie Dove Miles, who has recently adopted a Doberman who is fearful of literally everything.
Family dogs brawl with each other; a dog torments a child; a five-legged miniature pinscher has an aggressive attitude.
Cesar attempts to introduce Roscoe, an agoraphobic Akita who is too scared to leave the house and garden and has never been for a walk, to the outside world.
A Weimaraner eats everything in sight; a yellow Lab's excess energy is expressed destructively; an Australian shepherd is unable to socialize with other dogs.
Three canines with issues at a dog-friendly ad agency office; a border collie mix becomes excited and unresponsive to commands when in her owner's truck.
Velvet Revolver drummer Matt Sorum's French bulldog goes crazy at the sight of other dogs; Cesar helps a former therapy dog with aggression issues.

Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant Wall, and all the way to the finish line.
It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!
Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.
Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!
Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost baby fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

It's a bright, sunny morning, and Dora wants to say hello to her baby brother and sister. But when Dora gets to their room, she sees that the babies have climbed into their baby carriage and are heading for danger!

programmes.st: Dora and Diego to the Rescue!
programmes.d: It's a high-speed, around-the-world adventure as Dora and her cousin Diego chase after Boots, who's being carried off on his giant kite by a mighty wind. Dora and Diego need YOUR help as they cross the ocean.

It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid.  Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day!  But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programmes.st: Dora's Dance to the Rescue - HOUR SPECIAL
programmes.d: Put on your dancing shoes, because Dora needs you to spin, shake wiggle, jump and clap with her as she tries to rescue Swiper the fox, who's been trapped inside a bottle by a mean dancing elf.
Dora and Boots are exploring in the forest when they discover the gate to Fairy-Tale Land and enter this magical place. But...there's a mean witch who lives in Fairy-Tale Land.
Yo ho ho! Dora and Boots and all their friends are putting on a pirate show today for their mommies and daddies.
Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick, and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

It's Twins Day, and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too—a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

"Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

Benny is so excited—it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-karts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.
Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever—and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited because this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

"Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the shoe shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots—these are bouncy boots.
Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ball players. A long time ago in a Mayan kingdom, there was a big ball game championship.

programmes.st: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies
programmes.d: Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks, and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!

programmes.st: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show
programmes.d: ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!

It's Junk Day and Benny's showing Dora and Boots his wagon of cool junk. But when the junk truck accidentally takes Backpack and Map off to the junkyard, it's up to Dora, Boots, and Benny and his wagon of stuff to rescue them!

It's naptime for the twins, and Dora has a special Super Babies naptime story. Once upon a time, the Super Babies were getting ready for their nap, but the Dream Fairy never showed up because she was still asleep!

Pirate Piggy really wants to be in the big pirate treasure hunt, but his piggies got tummyaches. He needs at least 3 mates to help him find the sunken treasure. Dora, Boots, and L'il Piggy will be his pirate mates—yay!

Dora reads a story about a Wizzle who could grant wishes with his magic wand. On his birthday, it's his turn to make a wish, but the wand gets blown away by the wind. Dora needs your help to save the Wizzle's magic wand!

Dora and Boots are at an amusement park where they have a special wishing machine. Boots makes a wish: "I wish that when I say, 'bananas,' I get bananas." With a "boing," a bunch of bananas fall down on Boots.
Swiper is on Santa's naughty list! Dora believes Swiper can change and has to travel into the past and future to help him find 4 missing ornaments and learn the true meaning of Christmas.
Dr. Mike must judge her neighbors when litigation fever strikes Colorado Springs.
Dr. Mike tries to mediate a treaty with the Indians despite the arrival of a famed Indian hater.
The approach of Christmas finds Dr. Mike and Sully far from home, while Daniel ponders an offer to leave Colorado Springs.
Dr. Mike is shot point blank by a man with a grudge against doctors.
Colleen finds herself the subject of a fatal attraction.
Dr. Mike is sworn to secrecy when she learns that Loren plans to move away for good.
Dr. Mike matches medical skills with an elderly Chinese doctor and his 'grandson' to avert an epidemic.
Dr. Mike and Sully attempt to free cloud dancing from prison, as Teresa’s marriage to Jake is threatened by her aunt.
Dr. Mike must decide if a human birdman should be confined to a cage.
U.S. Marshall Elias Burch asks law-student Matthew to defend him when he’s accused of murder.
Michaela and Sully reminisce about the ups and downs of their relationship and make a momentous decision about their future.
Robert E vents his frustration over the death of his son and the demise of his marriage by stepping into the ring with a traveling boxing champion.
Dr. Mike’s elation at Colleen’s acceptance to medical school quickly turns to disappointment when colleen chooses to marry Andrew instead.
Byron Sully, an enigmatic man whose closest companions are the Indians and a wolf, becomes Mike's friend as she struggles for acceptance.
Dr. Quinn immediately takes action to stop the spread of a deadly epidemic.

Mike's stoic, disapproving Bostonian mother, Elizabeth, who, after years of estrangement, visits her daughter in Colorado Springs but finds her unconventional life on the frontier difficult to accept.

Charles Matthews tells Blake a grim secret; Zorelli finds a bug hidden in his apartment; Alexis tells Monica that Jason Colby isn't her father; Alexis learns she has a Fredrick Stahl original and realizes Blake's deep, dark secret.

Alexis threatens to sue Blake for half of the plundered Nazi treasure unless Sable withdraws her lawsuits against Colbyco. Sable agrees; Krystina leads Fallon to the treasure. They are followed by Dennis Grimes.
As Krystle Grant Jennings prepares to marry wealthy oil tycoon Blake Carrington, Matthew Blaisdel, a former lover, returns to town and causes her second thoughts.

Blake's estranged son Steven returns home for the ceremony, as does rebellious daughter Fallon, who objects to the union. Blake and Krystle reconcile; Matthew is reunited with his wife and daughter; Walter's rig is sabotaged.
Blake and Krystle are married; Jeff Colby pursues a disinterested Fallon; Walter and Matthew form a business partnership; Claudia and Lindsay try without success to resolve their differences.
Urgent business cuts short Blake and Krystle's honeymoon; Steven takes a job working for Matthew Blaisdel; Cecil proposes that Fallon marry his nephew.

Blake invites Matthew to dinner at the mansion to entice him to return to Denver-Carrington; Krystle clashes with head butler, Joseph; Matthew tells Krystle he's still in love with her; Jeff attempts to win Fallon.
Steven's ex-lover, Ted, arrives from New York; Fallon reluctantly marries Jeff Colby; Blake hires Michael, the chauffeur, to do undercover work for Denver-Carrington.
Steven is taunted on the job for being gay; Blake learns of the terms of Fallon's marriage to Jeff; Steven finds himself attracted to Claudia.
Walter takes Steven to a bordello; Steven is blamed for sabotaging Matthew's rig; Krystle pawns her diamonds to help Matthew financially.

After being fired for sabotaging Matthew's equipment, an innocent Steven learns he was set up; Lindsay is shattered to learn about her birth; Blake tries to learn who bankrolled Matthew; Fallon warns Steven's ex-lover to stay away from her brother.
Matthew and Walter's well comes in; Fallon asks to borrow the necklace Krystle pawned to help Matthew; at his mountain cabin, Steven and Claudia make love.

Steven announces he is moving out of the mansion; the chauffeur, Michael, tells Blake of Steven's affair with Claudia; Fallon resumes relations with Michael, until Blake has the chauffeur worked over; Lindsay sees her mother with Steven.
Blake learns Krystle pawned her emerald necklace to help out Matthew; Fallon tells Jeff she married him solely for her father's welfare; Steven's former lover, Ted, arrives in Denver.
Steven tells Claudia he spent the night with Ted; Krystle leaves Blake; seeing Ted embrace his son, Blake strikes him; Steven accuses his father of murder.
Blake must stand trial for the murder of Steven's lover; Krystle returns home to be with Blake. Fallon testified in her father's behalf but Steven refutes her statements in court.

On the witness stand, Blake maintains his innocence; Matthew learns of Claudia's affair with Steven; Claudia and daughter Lindsay are involved in an automobile accident; The prosecution calls in a mysterious witness that Blake is surprised to see.
Parents of a teenage girl disappear from a highway gas station.
Jess and Brooke investigate the disappearance of a woman from a plane while in flight.
Brooke and Jess search for a woman whose husband was blown up in his car.
Jess and Brooke search for the brother of a dying woman needing a bone marrow donor.
At the wedding of Eric's best friend, the groom is attack and the bride goes missing, pushing Brooke into the work mode.
The tragic loss of a loved one leaves family members with a sudden hole in their lives.
The Calloways and the Vaughns comfort one another as they navigate their way through the most trying ritual of their lives.
Reggie and Missy argue about the importance of modern manners and the role of social etiquette after they meet a wealthy Atlanta couple.
A scandal erupts after Cam's words during an interview are taken out of context, leading to the creation of the Calloway Philanthropic Trust.
Media consultant Missy copes with the fallout of a decision at a photo shoot for Cam; Chen and Cassie use technology to close the gap of a long-distance relationship.
Following a DNA test, Cassie meets a new family who helps her experience the traditions of the culture; Cam and Reggie attempt to get rid of Uncle Julius' gun.
Cam and Reggie return to Boston for a wedding; M-Chuck pursues relationships with many different women.
Reggie and Flaherty battle over a contract extension for Cam.
Cam learns secrets about his family's past, then must deal with the fallout.
Jacob makes Basie an offer to clear his debt and gain full control of Triumph II; Mac receives bad news from Skip Leonard, which puts him an explosive collision course with Grace.
Grace and Mac's showdown sends shockwaves through the family; Jacob offers the Bishop an olive branch; Kevin makes a decision that leaves Charity reeling.
Jacob and Kerissa establish their new ministry; Charity desperately tries to reach Kevin; Darius gets an offer that may take him out of Memphis, leaving Grace to wonder where she fits in his life.
When Sophia and Zora are excluded from the upcoming debutante Cotillion, Lady Mae sets out to make things right; Grace is inspired by Basie's sermon; Charity reaches out to Carlton.
Basie's sermon regarding inclusivity in the church goes viral, lighting a fire under Grace and provoking Bishop's suspicions; Kerissa pushes Jacob to get a day job.
A series of recurring nightmares leaves Grace unnerved; Charity looks to take her relationship with Jabari to the next level; Bishop gives Basie an ultimatum.
Lionel returns and drops a bombshell on Bishop and Lady Mae; Charity receives great news from Jabari; Jacob encounters resistance on his first day as head of Triumph.

Fleeing the liquor store, Richie’s visions worsen as the Gecko Brothers nearly collide with the Fullers.
Richie struggles with his visions. Seth makes a plan to cross the border. The Fullers suffer an RV breakdown.
Jet Li plays a bodyguard battling thieves targeting crown jewels at a Hong Kong hotel expo.
After losing his memory, a young man is abducted by a crime syndicate and molded into a deadly assassin.
Jackie Chan plays a quiet businessman seeking justice after an act of terrorism kills his daughter.
Arnold Schwarzenegger plays the sheriff of a small town that is about to be overrun by a notorious kingpin.
On his release from a prison sentence, a former cop connects a murder case to a government conspiracy.
The popular comic book character Judge Dredd is brought to life, starring Karl Urban.
A man teams up with his military brothers to rescue his fiancée from human traffickers. With Bruce Willis.
A former soldier navigating London's criminal underworld seizes the chance to assume a new identity.

Dr. Mike breaks the rules to enter her new horse in an important race.
Dr. Mike must prove that Loren’s sister-in-law did not murder her abusive husband.
A dead man walks when Halloween comes to Colorado Springs.
Jake is accused of killing a Cheyenne brave, and the incident disrupts the town, as well as the friendship between Sully and Cloud Dancing.
Dr. Mike clashes with a traveling faith healer over a cure for Kid Cole’s tuberculosis.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
When Michaela returns to Boston to visit her ailing mother, Sully must act before he loses her.
A severe drought threatens -- and divides -- Colorado Springs at Thanksgiving.
Dr. Mike suspects that Dorothy is spending time with Sully, and Becky thinks Colleen stole her boyfriend.
The children hide a wounded Sully from the cavalry, which has put a bounty on his head.

programmes.st: A Christmas Tale - Dr. Mike's Dream
programmes.d: Dr. Mike sees Christmas past, present and future with the help of a beloved friend.
When Matthew is trapped in a mine cave and Sully is his only hope for rescue.
A typhus epidemic spreads at Black Kettle's camp, and Dr. Mike feels responsible.
The Circus comes to town.
Another woman comes between Sully and Dr. Mike.
When Dr. Mike helps the reverend find parents for orphaned children, he gets ideas about marrying her.
Sully and Dr. Mike take desperate action as the battle between the Buffalo Soldiers and The Dog Soldiers escalates.

programmes.t: Legend of the Fist: The Return of Chen Zhen
programmes.d: Incredible martial arts sequences mark this thriller about a legendary fighter who takes on ruthless outside oppressors in World War II-era Shanghai.

Set in 198 A.D., when the Eastern Han Dynasty has collapsed into civil war, and the young Emperor is a puppet of prime minster and generalissimo Cao Cao (Jiang), the film singles out two famous chapters from Guan’s (Yen) many heroic adventures.
Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

An undercover cop (Donnie Yen) infiltrates one of China's most ruthless crime syndicates. He must risk everything to protect his family and his life after the boss (Collin Chou) vows to find and kill every traitor in his organization.
Four hundred years after being frozen in time, a Ming Dynasty palace guard and his three associates are thawed and left to adjust to the modern-day.
In the action-packed second chapter of the Iceman saga, Ying's heroic fight to rewrite history and reclaim his honor continues but those he trusts most may be leading into a deadly trap.
Released from prison, a kung-fu expert (Donnie Yen) tries to help the police find a vicious serial killer (Wang Baoqiang) who targets martial-arts masters.
Donnie Yen stars as infamous real-life drug kingpin Crippled Ho, who ruthlessly carved out his empire in 1960's Hong Kong.

Shan (Donnie Yen) is a hardline cop with a long history of success, but his past comes back to haunt him when a sting is attacked by a group led by his former protégé (Nicholas Tse), a man set on destroying everyone who ever wronged him.

Charlie and Itchy meet David, who'll spend his birthday in school. Charlie thinks it's awful and decides to break David out of class to give him the best birthday ever. They sneak David out of study hall and proceed to have a wonderful day.

While Charlie and Sasha playfully argue about who likes who more, Itchy arrives upset - Carface has stolen his collar! After a disastrous visit to Carface's hangout, the Curio Shop, Charlie decides they must break in a la 'Mission Impossible.'

Like 'The Odd Couple,' neatnick Itchy is forever cleaning up after sloppy Charlie. Anabelle warns them about setting a good example as guardian angels. When they can't, she uses a Miracle to put them in each other's bodies.

The Howards have been selected to be the All-American Family. However, with the press and media watching their every move, the family is concerned their secret will revealed. The family try to make a conscious effort to act as "normal" as possible.
A new family has moved to Wolverton, and they use their mysterious powers to turn the townspeople into zombies. The only people able to withstand their powers are the Howards.
Scott, Stiles, and Boof head downtown to celebrate Scott's winning touchdown, and Grandma gives him a special potion that will keep him from turning into a werewolf for the night.

Grandma's long-time foe, Zazu, places a curse on the family, which turns anyone the Howards touch into a werewolf. Zazu agrees to lift the curse if Scott can give her an old photograph of her and his grandparents.
When Pi sees Sabrina's Uncle Zamboni flying through the air he is convinced there are paranormal rumblings in Greendale. He makes it his mission to prove it to the townspeople.
Sabrina is tired of the restrictions that come with being a kid. She casts a spell that catapults into adulthood.
Sabrina ends up in a new docu-series called, That Witch which becomes an overnight sensation! Sabrina soon tires of the demanding schedule and lack of privacy.
When Sabrina hears that her Grandparents are coming for visit she is excited. They have a important announcement to make.

Charlotte follows Lewis to Max Hamilton. Max tells all to Charlotte when he discovers she’s the granddaughter of his one true love. Charlotte and Lewis almost break up until she goes to the moonpool, becoming a mermaid herself!

The girls have to deal with a fourth mermaid who turns out to be a loose cannon; Charlotte almost turns into a mermaid at a volleyball competition. Charlotte discovers she has all three mermaid superpowers.

As the girls continue to have problems accommodating Charlotte as a mermaid, Nate bullies Lewis. Despite the girls’ attempts to keep Charlotte under control, she uses her powers on Nate and almost exposes them all.

Charlotte takes over and organises a surprise party for Lewis, annoying Rikki. At the party, Charlotte is jealous of Cleo and traps her and Emma in a pool room. Rikki comes back just in time. From now on, Charlotte is on her own.
During a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Gus' powers mysteriously begin to fail while fending off Zarlak's forces. Investigation reveals that the magic-loss is affecting Gus' whole Elfin family.

Kasimir is stunned when she loses a Scootsoomer race to Lucrezia. Gus thinks Kazz is obsessed with winning and refuses to listen when Kazz says she thinks Lucrezia cheated. Kazz discovers a Leprechaun was forced to help her cheat and Zarlak.
The Enchanted School gets more than they expected when their new Librarian arrives. Aside from his immense knowledge of books, Professor Begelboyce brings tales of fantastic exploits.

Cassy is doing a report for Wish Giving Class when a powerful force from center-earth steals all her visual aides. We learn right away that it's Zarlak. He has coerced the legendary Ring of The Blue Moon.

Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, it can remove mermaid powers for good. Knowing this, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool but it backfires and Emma, Cleo and Rikki all look set to lose their powers.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Awakening
programmes.d: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will – and encounter a strange new force on Mako Island that turns water against them.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Jungle Hunt
programmes.d: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won't find the Moon Pool. The girls and Lewis discover the Moon Pool has changed.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Keep Your Enemies Close
programmes.d: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Valentine's Day
programmes.d: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.
Marshall and Simon must really use their heads to crack open the real story behind a homeless man who seems to have lost his mind.
Something very strange pops up when Simon, Dash, and Marshall try to crack the inner sanctum of Eerie's odd and exclusive lodge.
Rene Auberjonois plays the Donald, a PR wiz who puts Eerie into a shopping spree at World O' Stuff.
After finding a TV script in his mailbox, Marshall finds himself in Hollywood, his family out of character and his name 'Omri' - who's destined to die in the script.
Randall loves to invent things, even if it means destroying other peoples belongings.
Vincent will stop at nothing to win.
Brothers Dwight and Stu are willing to do just about anything to come up with the money for a new P-11 Baja Sandslicer dirtbike, including stealing.
On a family picnic, brothers Rick and Teddy spend their time keeping three year-old sister Becky out of trouble, and waging war on a hill of ants with squirt guns and magnifying glasses.
It’s Witch vs. Witch in the annual spell-a-thon, and Sabrina is determined she is going to cast the biggest and best spell of all.
Martin runs for condo board president and Frasier does all the work.

With her baby due any moment, Lucy finds it challenging trying to remain calm given Ricky's nervous behavior. When she asks the Mertzes to come over to offset Ricky, she winds up with three very anxious people.
Lucy gets caught up in a tormenting cycle of buying a useless appliance from a fast-talking salesman, then trading it in for something more expensive when trying to return it.

Could it be? Is Lucy Ricardo not funny? When Lucy's jokes fail to crack a smile amongst her friends and husband, she begins to develop an inferiority complex. Her depression gets worse when she discovers she's no good at bridge.

Ethel flashes back to the time when she and Lucy raced to win the presidency of their club, the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League. When Ethel was nominated for the position, Lucy bribed another member to nominate her.

Fred and Ethel overhear a fight between Ricky and Lucy...or did they? It seems Lucy is reading a murder mystery out loud to the amusement of Ricky. But when Ricky playfully throws the book at Lucy, she ends up with a black eye.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are out a restaurant and Lucy keeps changing her order and their seating. Ricky points out that she constantly changes her mind and never completes things.

The Ricardos' infant is cranky and keeps his parents as well as their neighbors up at night. When a neighbor, Mrs. Trumbull points out that the lease forbids children and threatens to move out along with other tenants.

Lucy and Ricky are exhausted from walking the baby at night and hire a maid. Lucy prepares a list of dos and don'ts in order to set down the law for her new employee. However when Mrs. Porter arrives, she has her own list for her employer.

Lucy wants to get into the act when Ricky is producing an Indian show at the Tropicana. Ricky instead hires the Mertzes to be part of the show, hoping Lucy will be cured of her show biz bug now that she is a mother.
Ricky has planned a surprise party for Lucy's birthday and swears the Mertzes and all their friends to secrecy. Lucy, however, only knows that everyone has forgotten her birthday.

Lucy decides that the Ricardos need a bigger apartment. She discovers that an older couple in the building just had their daughter move out and they no longer need the extra space. All she needs to do is to convince Ricky to go along with the trade.

An eligible bachelor is in town, and Lucy wants to set him up with a girlfriend of hers. The bachelor is a lingerie salesman by the name of Eddie Grant who is a friend of the Mertzes. Unfortunately, Lucy's attempts at matchmaking fail.
Without consulting Ricky, Lucy buys new living room furniture, using their old set as a down payment. Waiting for the right moment to tell Ricky the news, she hides the new furniture in the kitchen.

Lucy feels that she and Ricky are growing apart because they don't share many of the same interests. To make up for this, Lucy decides to invite herself along to a camping trip that Ricky and Fred are going on.

programmes.st: Ricky and Fred Are TV Fans
programmes.d: Dismayed that they can't seem to unglue their husbands from the boxing match on TV, Lucy and Ethel decided to go out for a bite to eat. However, at the local café they run into a similar problem.

The Ricardos have just purchased a new washing machine and despite their better judgment, agree to sell their old one to the Mertzes. The next day the old machine explodes with water and suds and the Mertzes insist that the deal is off.
Life magazine does a photo layout on the Ricardos and the only part of Lucy visible in the shot is her elbow. Lucy insists on getting a part in Ricky's act so that she can make a name for herself.

After watching two women walk out of a local dress shop with $200 in purchases, Lucy and Ethel decide to buy the shop and go into business for themselves. The first signs of trouble begin when they can't agree on a name for their store.

programmes.st: Lucy and Ethel Buy A Dress
programmes.d: The annual talent show for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League is going to be televised this year, and Lucy and Ethel are going to perform a duet. Everything is going well as Lucy gets Ricky to emcee the show and help her and Ethel prepare.
treated as if they were men. Later on, when the two couples go out to dinner, Fred and Ricky follow the ladies' instructions.

Ricky's friend Charlie Appleby and his wife Caroline are coming over for dinner at the Ricardos. Charlie is going to have Ricky emcee a TV program he's working on and so Ricky wants to make a good impression at dinner.
Ricky, Fred, and Ethel don't believe that Lucy could go one day without telling a lie. To prove their point, they bet her $100 that within 24 hours she'll be fibbing up a storm.

The Ricardos and Mertzes have a close encounter of the French kind when they go to a bistro and have no clue how to read the menu. Later on, Lucy and Ethel decide to brush up on their French in order to get into the show.
Ethel complains about how shabby her apartment is. She's ashamed of holding a meeting for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League at her place where women will be donning minks.

It all started with the good intention of getting Fred a new suit for his birthday. Lucy needed to "borrow" an old suit of Fred's for the correct measurements, but there was a witness to her burglary.

Lucy and Ethel are sick of their husbands dressing like slobs when they go out together in the evenings. After one particular outing, the girls get fed up and give their old clothes to a second-hand store.

Lucy gets another shot at being a star when a talent scout for the movies comes to town. Casting for the production agrees to audition Lucy after she gives him an impromptu performance of "There's No Business Like Show Business" with the Mertzes.

A magazine test has gotten Lucy into a tizzy. Lucy and Ricky take a test called "How to Rate Your Marriage." One of the questions in the quiz asks about old flames. When Lucy rattles off a list of old boyfriends, Ricky feels the need to compare.
Out of money, and in need of a million dollar idea, Lucy goes into the business of selling salad dressing. Marketing her salad dressing on TV, Lucy elicits Ethel's help with the advertisement.
Lucy plays the dominant parent role in their son's life. Realizing that he needs to spend more time with his son, Ricky agrees to spend his vacation at home to care for little Ricky.

The Ricardos are hosting an evening with friends. When the last guest to arrive introduces his date—all the men at the party fawn over her. Disgusted by the men's behavior, Lucy and Ethel begin to doubt their own feminine wiles.
Lucy and Ricky's thirteenth anniversary is rapidly approaching. In an outward show of affection, they buy each other gifts—golf clubs for Ricky and fur for Lucy.

The Ricardos are being interviewed for a "day-in-the-life" magazine article on happy married couples. The interviewer arrives at 7 AM just in time to encounter Lucy making breakfast in a frilly lace apron, while Ricky walks in wearing a smoking jacket.
One team shines during a wood staining flash challenge, monochromatic portraits send the artists into a panic, and one more artist is sent packing.
The artists push themselves to the limit in a grueling 12-hour Elimination Tattoo challenge, and the masters fight to gain an advantage in the finale.
The coaches face off live onstage, eliminated artists return to help the judges deliberate over the artists' 24-hour master canvases, and a new Ink Master is crowned.
Legendary rivals Cleen Rock One and Christian Buckingham make their epic returns, and 22 new artists compete for a spot on their teams.
Team Cleen and Team Christian face off in a fundamentals Flash Challenge, and the artists tackle a difficult Elimination Tattoo.
Team Cleen and Team Christian face off in a Flash Challenge featuring dominoes, and the Elimination Tattoo forces the artists to think outside the box.
The coaches face off in their first Grudge Match to keep their team safe from elimination, and the artists test their knack for consistency with wristband tattoos.
A Flash Challenge using electrical tape tests the teams' creativity, and the artists face challenging placements on their canvases during the Elimination Tattoo.
Christian and Cleen's artists work with their teammates in a tag-team tattoo on a single canvas, and one coach puts two of his artists on the chopping block.
Cleen and Christian tattoo four canvases in a grueling head-to-head marathon, and the artists design galactic Elimination Tattoos.
The artists use sidewalk chalk to create multidimensional images in the Flash Challenge, then they face off in a nature-scape Elimination Tattoo.
The coaches face off to save their teams from elimination, and the competitors test their artistry with mermaid Elimination Tattoos.
Cleen and Christian take control as each team is challenged to tattoo the rival coach's design, and the losing team tackles a freehand Elimination Tattoo.
Invisible paint is used to create artwork in the Flash Challenge, and the artists set out to capture the beauty of elaborate Japanese temples in the Elimination Tattoo.
The teams learn the devil's in the details during a wood-burning Flash Challenge, and a reflective Elimination Tattoo sends another artist packing.
The remaining artists work together with their teams to design powerful tattoos before facing off in head-to-head Grudge Matches.
The teams test their precision skills in a meticulous challenge using crayons, and an animal portrait Elimination Tattoo sends one more artist home.

programmes.st: The Suspicious Faith Healer and the Black Kirara

Kikyo was brought back to life by one of Urasue's secret techniques. She meets Monju, who is in the same situation.
In a certain village, Inuyasha and the gang are surrounded by villagers who dislike Miroku.
Inuyasha and the gang meet Izumo, who is investigating the secret of the creation of the Sacred Jewel.
Kagome and the others are kidnapped by demons who are using fake Sacred Jewels. Inuyasha and the rest go to save them, but Gyuoh stands in their way.
Naraku's poisonous bugs appear. Sesshomaru goes after them. Meanwhile, Jaken is stung by a poisonous bug and is dying. Rin is left with him.
Kirara disappears. Sango is worried. Shippo deduces Kirara's reasons for disappearing.

programmes.d: Kagome is lured to a cave by a voice calling for help. Kagome enters the cave and meets Kikyo.

programmes.d: Ginta and Hakkaku fight with Koga over something small, and end up working separately from him. As they do, they meet Sesshomaru's group.

programmes.st: The Truth Behind the Nightmare: Battle in the Forest of Sorrow

programmes.st: The Snow from Seven Years Past

A giant ogre appears in the mountains to the north. His name is Kyokotsu. Kyokotsu eats demons when he can. He attacks the demon wolf tribe.
The Band of Seven, a group of ghosts, have been brought back to life.
The match between Jakotsu and Inuyasha is stopped when Mukotsu interferes. Mukotsu kidnaps Kagome to make her his bride.
Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have been weakened by Mukotsu's poison.

programmes.st: Inuyasha Shows His Tears For The First Time
programmes.d: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have stopped breathing. Inuyasha searches for the Band of Seven to avenge them.

programmes.st: The Secret of the Pure Light
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang approach the light of a Sacred Jewel which appears to belong to the Band of Seven, but the light is not corrupt.

programmes.st: Enter Bankotsu, The Leader of the Band of Seven

programmes.st: The Big Clash: Banryu versus the Wind Scar

programmes.d: There is a holy island in a lake surrounded by mist. Saint Hakushin, who become a living Buddha a hundred years ago, is venerated there.

programmes.st: The Sacred Vajra and the Mystery of the Living Buddha
programmes.d: Bankotsu gets Kagome and the others involved in his battle with Inuyasha. Inuyasha is angered that his friends are getting hurt, and corners Bankotsu.
Mt. Hakurei's holy barrier prevents demons from entering it. Saint Hakushin helped Naraku, and placed the barrier.
Mt. Hakurei gets stronger, and Kikyo is prevented from going into its hold ground.
Suikotsu cannot kill Chiyo and the others. Jakotsu stops him. He senses an attack from Sesshomaru.

programmes.st: Vanished in a River of Flames
programmes.d: Ginkotsu has died, and Renkotsu uses his shard without permission. In doing so, he has betrayed Bankotsu. He cannot go back anymore.

programmes.st: Into the Depths of Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: The evil within Mt. Hakurei is Naraku's demons and Kagura. Miroku risks his life to save Sango, by opening his Wind Tunnel and sucking in the demons.
Miroku and Sango come face to face with the Saint Hakushin's mummy on Mt. Hakurei. The saint tells them his reason for helping Naraku.
Inuyasha regains his demon powers. He defeats Jakotsu, and hurries to Mt. Hakurei. Renkotsu has rebellious feelings towards Bankotsu.

programmes.st: Final Battle: The Last and Strongest of the Band of Seven
programmes.d: Mt. Hakurei's barrier disappears. Inuyasha is worried about Kagome. Kagome heads to Mt. Hakurei with Koga and the others.

programmes.st: The Power of Banryu: Duel to the Death on Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: Miroku and Sango see a mysterious lump of flesh in the depths of Mt. Hakurei.
Naraku has gained a new body and has been reborn.

When Jane realizes that she and Michael are both stressed out, they decide to recreate their first date to help them relax. Rogelio makes a big scene on the red carpet of his film premiere and his rant goes viral.

Working in publishing is not what Jane thought it would be, until she learns about a showcase for up and coming writers. With Petra helming the Marbella, she decides to rebrand the hotel, but quickly butts heads with the rival hotel next door.

When Jane is offered a book deal, she thinks her prayers have been answered and debates quitting her publishing job. After suffering from panic attacks, Jane is ready to get to the root of the problem. Rogelio and Xo work on fixing their friendship.

When Jane messes up at Mateo's school, Petra convinces Jane to help with the preschool fundraiser to get in the good graces of the preschool's director. Jane is excited for her first meeting with her editor, but it does not go the way she expected.

Jane feels guilty that she isn't around for Mateo as much as she would like, so she decides to run for Room Mom against none other than perfect mom, Petra. Alba tries to impress her crush, but it doesn't go well.

Jane is finally ready to get back in the dating game so she enlists the help of Rafael and Petra, but it seems they have their own issues to work on. Alba takes Xo and Jane's advice about being an independent woman when it comes to Jorge.

Jane is finally a published author but she's reluctant to talk about her past to help sell her book. Rogelio is intimidated by his new younger male co-star and begins to wonder if the newbie is trying to sabotage him.

Jane is ready for some casual dating and is pleasantly surprised when her date actually helps her fix things with Lina. Petra follows a lead with the help of Chuck that could help her sister's case. Rafael takes Jane's advice.

Jane has to learn how to handle her new love life, especially when the guy she is dating introduces her to his grandmother. Petra learns some interesting information about Chuck. Xo and Rogelio are eager to share their news with Jane.

Jane and Fabian are not on the same page when it comes to their relationship, which makes it hard for Jane to ask him for a favor. Petra and Rafael both turn to Jane for advice, but Jane is determined not to get involved.

Jane struggles to find the right words for Rogelio and Xo's ceremony, when she learns about a mysterious letter that Michael wrote before their wedding. Rogelio and Xo are excited for their big day, but Rogelio gets some shocking news.
When Jane is reunited with her first love, Adam (guest star Tyler Posey), she is shocked but happy to see him, however Xo and Alba are less thrilled that he is back.
Jane's new relationship with Adam helps bring out her fun side and reminds her that she isn't just a mom. However, when Adam gets a job opportunity and doesn't know if he should stay or go.
Jane and Adam's relationship seems to be moving at hyper-speed, and Jane thinks that it might be time for him to meet Mateo, but Rafael is not happy with this idea.
When Jane learns that Rafael introduced Mateo to his new girlfriend, Katherine, without her consent, she gets angry since she thinks Katherine has a negative influence on Rafael and Mateo.
When Adam reveals his dating past to Jane, the information puts a strain on their relationship.  Lina  seeks Jane's advice about whether she should get married.
Jane's book is finally being released but her plans to have a party at the local bookshop where she was inspired to be a writer hit a snag.
