Andy's girlfriend Peggy McMillan gets along fine with Andy until he discovers that her father is rich.
A poor farmer successfully auditions to sing at a concert. Barney and Andy take it upon themselves to spruce him up for the event.
Aunt Bee becomes warden for a day when she disciplines Otis Campbell after he is arrested for his usual drunken behavior.
Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern criminal detection methods to solve several burglaries at a filling station.
Opie becomes jealous when his father appears to be paying special attention to a pretty girl -- even taking her fishing with them.
Andy, Barney and Gomer are a trio of laughs as they tread the boards of a haunted house.
Opie's an unwilling participant when he's betrothed to marry a mountain family's daughter.
Andy thinks Ellie is out to marry him. After a series of misunderstandings, Andy finally takes Ellie to the church picnic.
Opie learns a lesson in friendship when he befriends a newcomer to Mayberry.
Barney organizes a rescue party when Andy and Helen are trapped in a cave by a landslide.
British comedian Bernard Fox plays an Englishman who returns to Mayberry and upsets Aunt Bee with his efficiency.
An old penniless citizen of Mayberry forestalls his eviction by trying to redeem a century-old municipal bond.

programmes.d: Jamie reinvents a roast chicken by combining it with the flavors of a Margherita pizza-basil, tomato and mozzarella -to create a glorious new family favorite, then whips up his Prawn toast toasties, the perfect snack for sharing.

programmes.t: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programmes.st: Avocado Hollandaise and Speedy Sausage Pizza
programmes.d: Jamie rustles up his restaurant-quality avocado hollandaise, and then he gets his son Buddy involved in cooking a different pizza for all the family to enjoy.
Chef Jamie Oliver prepares pot-roasted ham hocks with parsley sauce, while roasting butternut squash to add to spinach rotolo.

Jamie makes a piri piri pork belly with crispy crackling to show how a thrifty cut of meat and some clever cooking can deliver a real family feast at a fraction of the cost of pork chops, fillet or loin.
Jamie makes crispy Camembert parcels, autumn salad and cranberry dip, plus a golden chicken with braised greens and potato gratin.
Jamie creates a beef stroganoff, with fluffy rice and red onion and parsley pickle; Moroccan mussels with tapenade toasties and cucumber salad.
Fish baps, mushy peas and tartar sauce; mushroom farfalle with blue cheese; hazelnut and apple salad.
Jamie cooks lamb lollipops with curry sauce, rice and peas, and prawn linguine with Sicilian shaved fennel salad.

programmes.st: Chicken Dim Sum and Crab Briks
programmes.d: On the menu this time is chicken dim sum, coconut buns, cucumber pickle and hoisin sauce; crackin' crab briks, couscous salad and salsa.
Jamie cooks crispy duck and hoisin lettuce parcels, chicken cacciatore, and spaghetti and smoky tomato sauce.
Moroccan bream; couscous salad; pomegranate and harissa; British burgers; shred salad; pickles and things.
Jamie makes jerk pork, grilled corn and crunchy tortilla salad, minestrone, poached chicken and salsa verde.
Flaky pastry pesto chicken; spicy nduja vongole; surf and turf pasta; sausage bake; watermelon granita.
Sticky kickin' chicken wings; sirloin with aubergines; creamy garlic mushroom pasta; rum 'n' raisin ice cream.
Thai-style crispy sea bass; veggie tray bake; sweet chicken surprise; and pineapple carpaccio, a tropical dessert made in minutes.
Mustardy beef that uses only five ingredients; baked saffron rice; steamed salmon niçoise; plum tarte tatin.
Jamie cooks a smoky chorizo salmon, potato and artichoke al forno, a lamb hotpot and a walnut-whip affogato.
Jamie creates chickpea and chard pork, egg fried rice, beef carpaccio with Egyptian spice, and a simple fish pie.

programmes.st: Lamb Kofta; Broad Bean Salad; Alaska
programmes.d: Lamb kofta flatbreads; a Spanish-inspired broad bean salad with Manchego cheese salad; peanut chicken; peach and almond Alaska.
A bite-sized, snackable clip selection of Jamie's most-loved recipes and top kitchen moments.
Culinary queen Mary Berry goes down memory lane for a seafood feast. Jimmy bakes gooey bread, Jamie makes beef wellington, and the boys cook with the RAF.
Ant and Dec take on a beginner's guide to Japanese cooking.

Comedian Rob Beckett helps create an all-you-can-eat Chinese buffet. Jamie makes a melt-in-your-mouth pie. And, Jimmy takes Friday night nibbles to another level with potato spirals and stuffed jalapeños wrapped in bacon.
Jamie and Jimmy return to their end-of-the-pier caff with blow-out feasts, D.I.Y. gastronomy, celeb friends at the hob and more trips on the road continuing their fight against food waste.
A gang of desperadoes terrorizes Bakersville and the surrounding countryside.
A cattle baron's plan for becoming king of the Arizona territory involves murder.
The friends find escaped convicts and treasure.
When a newspaper opposes him, a crooked politician steals the press.
A young widow is harassed by the gang that killed her husband.
An old pioneer nearly loses his life when three escaped killers visit him.
Tonto and the Lone Ranger search for a white man who's responsible for murders and Indian uprisings.
A misguided youth learns values.
Aunt Maggie sets fire to a shack where the Ranger and Tonto are prisoners.
The Lone Ranger and Tonto go after an unscrupulous lawyer who has been forging documents.
The Lone Ranger stops a runaway stagecoach.
A country doctor helps track an outlaw band.
A bank robber poses as the Lone Ranger.
A mob blames a freight-line owner for a gold robbery.
The Lone Ranger and Tonto disguise themselves as clowns to pursue an outlaw.
A woman seeks revenge for an old injustice.
A bounty hunter plans to turn in an outlaw, then help him escape.
A tenderfoot tries to replace his murdered lawman brother.
A retired outlaw offers shelter to a pair of bank robbers until he sees the influence they have on his grandson.
A hypnotist steals Hardrock Hazen's gold.
Ruthless Hutch Conent controls new sheriff Jack Morrison's town.
Sheriff Will falls for a spy for an outlaw gang.
The Lone Ranger takes a stand for freedom of the press when he battles the publisher of a newspaper.
A reformed outlaw discovers that his old trademark -- a pair of black dice -- is found at murder scenes.
The daughter of a recently murdered newspaper publisher rebels against the man who has oppressed the town.
A mission-educated Indian girl finds her efforts to teach her people stymied by her brother's hostility.
A calculating man, desperate for gold, frames Tonto for murder.
A boy hero-worships escaped outlaw Gaff Morgan.
A mine owner who was robbed is in danger of losing everything because he can't pay the mortgage.
The Miles brothers terrorize a town and plot to kill the Lone Ranger.
A band of outlaws masquerading as Indians wages a campaign of terror on the homesteaders.
Citizens of Mesa are divided by old loyalties.
A monogrammed glove and a child's wooden rifle are the clues found near a dead man.
The Lone Ranger and Tonto help a 22-year-old cowboy who assumes the responsibilities of town sheriff.
A convicted gunman impersonates the Lone Ranger in his hateful attempt to get revenge.
The Lone Ranger and Tonto confront a gang of hoods who kill an elderly marshal in a reign of terror.

programmes.st: Ages Of Man / Families / Bo 'N Sam
programmes.d: Julie ends up in the middle of an unusual love triangle when the visiting 13-year-old son of the head of the cruise line develops a crush on her at the same time that she is trying to win over a charming older passenger.

programmes.st: Sounds Of Silence / Cyrano De Bricker / Murder On The High Seas
programmes.d: A singer tries to persuade his manager to let him abandon the shock tactics that made him famous and let his music speak for itself.

programmes.st: Super Mom / I'll See You Again / April's Return
programmes.d: One-time stowaway April Lopez returns to the ship as a popular singer. However, she grows tired of the hassles of fame and decides that she would like to become a cruise director.

programmes.st: Third Wheel / Grandmother's Day / Second String Mom
programmes.d: Gopher gives his parents a cruise as a Mother's Day present. Gopher's father grows jealous of the close relationship between mother and son.

programmes.st: The Wedding / Carol & Doug's Story / Peter & Alicia's Story / Buddy & Portia's Story / Julie's Story - Part 1
programmes.d: Julie catches love fever on the high seas and is thinking of marriage when the Pacific Princess is chartered for a dazzling star-studded wedding cruise that takes Capt. Stubing, his crew, and their guests on a beautiful scenic journey to Alaska.

programmes.st: The Wedding / Carol & Doug's Story / Peter & Alicia's Story / Buddy & Portia's Story / Julie's Story - Part 2
programmes.d: Wealthy Alaskan Buddy Bowers (Lorne Greene) recruits the services of the ship to take the wedding party from Vancouver, B.C., to Skagway, Alaska, for the nuptial ceremonies for his orphaned granddaughter, Carol (Lisa Hartman).

programmes.st: Going My Way / Dance With Me / Doc, Be Patient
programmes.d: When Doc (Bernie Kopell) gets the flu, he receives private treatment from a gorgeous doctor (Susan Sullivan) who keeps his fever up even when his temperature drops.

programmes.st: The Audit Couple / My Boyfriend's Back / The Scoop
programmes.d: A strict IRS auditor (Phyllis Diller) falls for Capt. Stubing (Gavin MacLeod) until she finds something in his file.

programmes.st: Crew Confessions / Haven't I Seen You? / The Reunion
programmes.d: Isaac (Ted Lange) has trouble on the high seas when the Love Boat crew discovers he has included some racy tales about them in his new novel.

programmes.st: A New Woman / Trial Romance / Never Say Goodbye
programmes.d: In a poignant episode, Capt. Stubling (Gavin McLeod) is reunited with his love child, Vicki (Jill Whelan).

programmes.st: Brotherhood Of The Sea / Daddy's Pride / Letter To Babycakes
programmes.d: When Julie (Lauren Tewes) joins the ship's secret all-male club, she is shocked by the initiation rites.

programmes.st: They Tried To Tell Us We're Too Young (aka Too Young To Love) / Eleanor's Return / Not Now, I'm Dying
programmes.d: A swinging bachelor (Dack Rambo) gets the shock of his life when the phony story he tells his gorgeous girlfriend (Barbi Benton) turns out to be true.

programmes.st: The Next Step / Life Begins At 40 / The Stimulation Of Stephanie
programmes.d: A college professor (Dick Martin) turns the Love Boat into a laboratory to test the romantic responses of his lovely female student (Char Fontane).

programmes.st: Happy Ending / We Three / April's Love
programmes.d: A tantalizing entertainer (Charo) receives some unwanted advice on love from members of the crew, who don't approve of her marriage plans.

programmes.st: Kinfolk / Sis & The Slicker / Moonlight & Moonshine / Too Close For Comfort / The Affair: Part 1
programmes.d: In a special two-hour presentation, a singer (Donny Osmond) trying to break into show business finds out unexpectedly that his hillbilly family has decided to take the cruise.

programmes.st: Rent A Romeo / Matchmaker, Matchmaker / Y'gotta Have Heart
programmes.d: Doc (Bernie Kopell) comes down with a bad case of heartache when the beautiful girl (Misty Rowe) he wants to be alone with boards ship with her ever-present sister (Vicki Lawrence).

programmes.st: Dumb Luck / Tres Amigos / Hey, Jealous Lover
programmes.d: A brilliant plain-Jane (Shelley Hack) becomes a fetching glamour gal with the help of Julie (Lauren Tewes), and falls in love with a man (Kevin Tighe) who has some mistaken ideas about her.

Lucas tries to get help when he is shot after witnessing a murder.
After being foreman of a jury that convicted an Apache, Lucas is marked for death. Now, he must discover who is behind the curse.
Lucas allows some snowed-in stagecoach passengers to stay with him until the roads are passable. Trouble brews when the whiskey salesman and gunfighter fall for the same woman.
Two pranksters write away for a mail-order bride, using Lucas's name.
Lucas recognizes Dr. Battle as an ex-gunslinger with whom he once fought. He helps with a dying man, but Lucas and the doctor have unresolved anger.
A Chinese man and his son fight prejudice as they try to open a laundry in North Fork.
While Lucas and Mark are traveling across the Mexican desert they encounter a trio of Mexican bandits who demand payment to cross "their" desert.
Mark takes a job as a stable boy against his father's wishes.
Mark and Milly are held hostage in her general store when two gunmen attempt a daring robbery.
Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas turns them down because they are escorting a murderer, to be hanged in Yuma.
Mark goes to work for Will Temple, a badly scarred, very mysterious rancher.
Corey Hazlett insists he's innocent of murder, despite Lucas's eyewitness testimony.
Lucas tries to dissuade a latter-day knight from rushing into battle.
Abe Lincoln's claim that he's the Great Emancipator amuses everyone except Matt Yordy.
Stubborn Grandpa Fogarty is Lucas's main roadblock as he tries to get young Woody Fogarty to attend school.
Mark Twain visits North Fork and quickly alienates the townspeople.
Lucas tries to stop embittered John Holliver from venting his wrath on the people who expelled him from town years before.
Lucas becomes the target of a vengeful mountaineer after he is responsible for a young mountain boy's death.
When Mark is kidnapped and held for ransom, he finds himself an unwilling companion of gunman Carl Avery.
Lucas seeks an escape when he's captured by outlaws while seeking help for an injured Mark.
The young Queen-to-be of France hides out in North Fork with her sick brother.
A notorious killer is being held in the North Fork jail. When word gets around that Gordo's gang is on its way to free him, the whole town becomes frightened.
Lucas's old Army pal settles in North Fork with his deaf daughter.
An Englishman arrives with a custom-made rifle and a plan to kill Lucas.
Mark falls head-over-heels in puppy love.
Banker Hamilton is closing up for the day when Rudy Gray persuades him to stay open for one more transaction...a withdrawal at gunpoint.
Tip Corey, the son of a man allegedly murdered in North Fork, has a killer's reputation and comes to town to kill Micah.
Len Richards and his brother, Ab, confront a Lucas McCain look-alike, Earl Bantry and his sidekick K.C. Peters, for slaughtering one of Richards' steers.
Lucas and Mark stop on the way to the county fair to deliver a message to Micah, who is escorting a prisoner to be hanged. Mark and Lucas recognize the prisoner.
Mark and Milly are shocked when Lucas begins gambling. They don't know that Lucas is "undercover" trying to catch a man cheating.
Mark befriends singer-banjoist Lafayette Bly, a blind man with an acute sense of hearing and a very strong grip.
A retired lawman's irrational jealousy threatens not only to destroy his marriage but also to make him an easy target for someone who wants him dead.
No one is more surprised than Micah when newcomer Leota Carraway claims he's her long-lost husband and the father of her child.
When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...
A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.
The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.
Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.
A lonely man falls in love with a mini museum doll, which he believes is alive.
On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.
A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!
Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."
A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.
On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.
Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.
A man travels back in time to try to prevent some of history's catastrophes.
A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

programmes.st: Stopover in a Quiet Town (aka Strangers in Town)
programmes.d: Bob and Millie wake up to find they are in a strange town. Everything appears to be props - trees, animals even cars.
The Kanamits, 9-foot tall aliens, arrive on Earth with one lofty goal: To Serve Man.
The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.
A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.
A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.
An alien who crash-lands into a remote mountain village stirs up the villagers' fears and animosity, but he befriends a little boy and gives him a mysterious present.
A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide
Cavender, an angel trying to win his wings, tries to help down-on-her-luck Agnes, who has just been fired.

At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.

programmes.st: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programmes.d: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

programmes.st: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programmes.d: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.
Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programmes.st: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programmes.d: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.
Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.
Adam Grant is trapped in a recurring nightmare, in which he is sentenced to death and executed.
An over-ambitious general plans to rise to the presidency of the U.S. because of his reputation as a ruthless Indian fighter.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Headless Woman
programmes.d: Secret agents West and Gordon work to avert the destruction of the American Cotton industry.
Agents West and Gordon struggle to bring to justice a weirdly garbed, artillery-equipped gang of bank robbers.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Underground Terror
programmes.d: Former inmates of a Civil War prison camp seek revenge against the camp commandant because of his alleged atrocities against them.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Death Masks
programmes.d: A murderer trapped by agent James T. West breaks out of prison with a bizarre plan to assassinate him.
Secret agent West is attacked while guarding a precious cargo of smallpox vaccine and loses his memory from a blow on the head.
Agents West and Gordon encounter voodoo rites and a diabolical biologist and his throng of robot-like slaves.
Secret agents West and Gordon face a killer beast and a mystery guarded by a senator and his three sons.
A would-be dictator's attempt to assassinate President Ulysses S. Grant brings him up against secret agents West and Gordon.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Big Blackmail
programmes.d: A double-dealing foreign diplomat attempts to implicate the United States in an international conspiracy.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Doomsday Formula
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon are determined to foil an ex-army general's plan to gain possession of a secret explosive formula.
A man uses a steam-driven juggernaut to drive off homesteaders so he can appropriate their oil-rich land.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Sedgewick Curse
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon come across a physician plying a wealthy family with a drug that causes rapid aging.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Gruesome Games
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon, searching for a powerful germ culture, invade the mansion of an eccentric millionaire.
A strange sea monster preying on Portuguese fishermen and their boats becomes the object of an investigation by agents West and Gordon.
West and Gordon must escape a Western town whose entire population is hunting them to free the prisoner they have taken.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Egyptian Queen
programmes.d: Secret Service agent James West seeks to find a missing ruby for an Egyptian Princess.

programmes.st: Musings of a Cigarette Smoking Man
programmes.d: The agents learn the truth behind the assassination of JFK and Area 51.
A deadly, viscous organism is discovered inside a strange rock.
Mulder gains proof the organism inside the rock is an alien entity.
Prophetic dreams send Mulder on a search for a serial killer’s victims.
Mulder and Scully track the mythical creature known as El Chupacabra
A decapitated medic may be an evolutionary freak capable of regeneration.
Scully begins dating a man whose jealous tattoo compels him to murder.
Mulder breaks into a lab to find the cure that could save Scully’s life.
The agents uncover a murder that may have been committed by a dead man.
A seemingly invisible Vietnam vet begins killing the military’s top brass.
The agents investigate the unexplained crash of a commercial airliner.
Passengers aboard a plane are sacrificed in pursuit of alien technology.
Scientists found frozen to death may have been killed by a time traveler.
The father of babies born with vestigial tails is a chameleon-like man.
Skinner helps the Cigarette-Smoking Man destroy evidence in a bee attack.
Ghostly images of female victims start to appear near murder scenes.
Mulder becomes the prime suspect in an apparent double homicide.

Janet is thrilled with her new job as an aerobics teacher, and her new boss Tina is thrilled with Jack. When Tina blackmails Jack into being at her beck and call, Larry offers to take her off Jack's hands.
Jack has to do a lot of double-talking on his first night as a busboy at a posh French restaurant when the gang comes to dinner expecting him to be the head chef. Guest Star(s): Michael Lombard
75-year-young veteran actor J.Pat O'Malley takes a lesson from the "youngsters" by forming his own "oldster-trio" in a geriatric apartment commune.

Accident-prone Cindy appears to have taken the ultimate misstep when she starts collecting maternity clothes, leading Jack to make an astonishingly funny marriage proposal. Guest Star(s): Frances Lee McCain
Jack believes Chrissy's friend is the perfect sweetie to bring home to mom, until Janet discovers she's a high-priced call girl headed for a wild convention.
Chrissy cranks out amateur movies of Jack and Janet, and is misled into thinking she has an "interesting" talent for film making.
When Jack, Chrissy, and Janet set out for a gourmet dinner for the Ropers - designed to stave off an expected rent hike - the " meanest" sailor from Jack's navy days arrives and wrecks the evening.
Jack and Chrissy walk in while Janet is entertaining a date, fostering a new rule on privacy.
Jack angrily leaves and becomes a live-in cook for Larry's boss and his passionate wife. Guest Star(s): John Larroquette
Chrissy and Janet have to solve a gourmet mystery to help Jack graduate from cooking school.

Cheryl asks Jack to father her child, but Jack refuses. Janet thinks Cheryl wants to marry Jack because she's going to have his baby, so she talks Jack into complying with Cheryl's wishes. Guest Star(s): Joanna Kerns
Chrissy's good fortune at the racetrack leaves the three roommates with money to burn but tempers sizzle over the distribution of the wealth.
Jack breaks a date with Janet to coach a nervous Larry, who's hoping to romance Terri with a smooth conversation.
Instead of catching sleep in the dingy apartment above his restaurant, Jack catches Mr. Angelino with a young woman.
Jack, Chrissy, and Janet find out how far Mr. Roper's garden has gone to pot when they find some unusual plants while weeding it.
A fault-finding efficiency expert drives Janet to quit her job at the flower shop.
A case of mistaken identity lands Jack an impressive chef's post that makes him the unwitting target of a bullying bookie and the local police.
Jack panics when he suspects Terri's friend wants to give up her life as a nun and marry him.
Janet and Chrissy think it's great when they learn that Jack is dating a "fantastic" older woman.
Janet learns that Cindy's boss is asking for favors above and beyond the call of duty.

Jack writes a nasty letter to a famous food critic, thinking the critic is going to give his bistro a ruinous review. When the critic assures Jack the review will be favorable, Jack tries to retrieve the letter from the critic's desk.
Jack pretends he's a doctor to impress his visiting grandfather, who's eager to observe Jack's hospital practice.
When Jack's never-ending schemes to endear himself to a beautiful woman totally backfire, he decides to forego his little white lies for honesty.

Jack believes he has won a baking contest that is open only to women. Disguised as "Grandma Tripper," he goes to collect the check and learns that he is a finalist and must bake his cookies for the company's executives to win the prize.
Jack is conned into renting a small restaurant - only to discover that it's a run-down disaster. Guest Star(s): Jordan Charney
Jack becomes caught in a dilemma when Chrissy believes he has bought her an expensive birthday present and the gift turns out to be a surprise for Roper's wife.

A customer of the flower shop names Janet in his will, and she receives a vase. His nephew, Philip, an art collector, visits Janet, and Jack thinks he lied about the value of the vase and is trying to get it back.
When the roommates meet their new landlord they discover they have accidentally sold all his furniture, thinking it was the Ropers!
The trio's outrageous escapades result in an eviction notice from Furley and they get ready to move into a luxurious rent-free penthouse.

Jack offers to model for a beautiful art teacher and finds himself nude in front of her classroom when Furley walks in. Jack begs Furley not to tell, but the secret is out when a nude portrait of Jack appears at the Regal Beagle.
Jack defends Chrissy's honor when a man who misunderstood her friendliness shows up at the apartment and no one knows he's a cop. Guest Star(s): James Cromwell
A letter to a lovelorn column convinces Chrissy and Janet that the other is having a love affair with Jack.
Jack Tripper's cooking lesson with the seductive wife of a mobster becomes dangerously spiced with hot romance.

programmes.t: Victorious: Three Girls And A Moose
programmes.d: Tori, Cat, and Jade compete with each other to win the affection of Beck's big, handsome, hockey-loving Canadian friend, Moose.

When Tori gets invited to sing the national anthem at a televised basketball game, she worries she'll forget the lyrics, but ends up in a much more embarrassing encounter with the team's mascot.

Andre gets Tori a job at a frozen yogurt stand, but work may keep them from performing at the Hollywood Arts Cowboy Luau.  Robbie wants to ask Cat to the luau, but asks someone else, making Cat jealous.
Tori and the gang compete to see who can get the most followers on The Slap.  But when they get caught up in the competition, they neglect their schoolwork and their friendships.
Tori wins a contest to sing the opening number at a big music awards show, but the producer wants to totally change her look and behavior. Tori agrees, but finds that she doesn't like her new image.

After Tori fills in for her ailing sister in a big musical showcase, Tori is asked to enroll at an elite performing arts high school.  But once there, Tori struggles to fit in to her new surroundings.
Tori goes all out to master an iconic Hollywood Arts monologue in Sikowitz's class.  Meanwhile, André and Robbie join a ballet class to meet girls, with disastrous results.
Tori has to defend herself after Jade claims Tori hurt her in a stage fighting exercise.  Meanwhile, Trina has to fend off Robbie's advances when he thinks their stage kiss meant something.
Tori accidentally gets Beck fired from a small role in a movie, then must figure out a way to get him his job back.  Meanwhile, Robbie suffers frightening nightmares about his best friend Rex.
Tori gets the lead in a high profile school musical, but freaks out when a stage makeup project goes awry, and she's left looking like a zombie on opening night.
After a jealous Jade dumps Beck, she soon regrets it and recruits Tori to help get him back.  Meanwhile, Trina puts on a one-woman show and tells Robbie he better give it a good review… or else!
Tori struggles to find the perfect birthday gift for Trina, then decides to write her sister a song as a present.  An ungrateful Trina turns the song into cash by selling it, enraging Tori.

Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop.  Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.

A man died in his home after a long history of heart disease. It was assumed that this was the cause of his death. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surfaced that the death was no accident.

In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her home, and it changed the feeling of security residents had in the small town of Waseca, Minnesota. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.
In 1962, the people of the small town of Hanford, California, lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies that targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived despite severe injuries.

A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a time-stamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.
At a murder scene, investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs, and unknown fingerprints. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. The similarities in the cases were striking, and examiners must determine if the suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors can discover the cause until she visits the gynecologist for a routine checkup. Then she learns it's something far worse than the flu.

Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.
Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed, and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker.

A man is found dead in his home, and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine the time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist, and a short-order cook answer their question.

A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to reexamine the motives of this so-called hero.
A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder and that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

When firefighters found an entire family dead inside their home, it looked like a murder-suicide, but there were several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card, and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

Two men were murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroyed a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips, and a chicken feather could link what appeared to be two separate crimes.

A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. The case stalls for more than a year, and then investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA data bank.

With no forensic evidence inside a murder scene, investigators were baffled. But they suspected that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If she had, forensic scientists would have had to find a way to find out what the dog had seen.
Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

A woman was found dead in a ravine, but crucial crime scene evidence had been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turned cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brought the killer to justice.

When an 11-year-old girl disappeared from a small town in a remote area of Alaska, investigators wondered if she'd been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. It turned out neither was true.

Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.
For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to the police and the New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people, one for each astrological sign.

A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep, and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months passed, then years, and the crime was never solved. Then Kathleen's family hired a private investigator, who discovered her diary.
The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist, and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

The investigation of the kidnapping of a prominent banker's wife led police on a wild goose chase. An unexpected discovery made by an entomologist led to a new suspect and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

A mark found on a young woman's dead body enables police to track the killer.
A woman's deadly walk in the woods was ruled a hunting accident until a strange letter appeared.

Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire that killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appeared to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On a closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

A beautiful young woman fell to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators thought it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police had a very different picture of what happened.

Residents of Noel, Missouri, were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed, and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.
Investigators try to find the cause of a woman's arsenic poisoning.

A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed, and his wife told two different versions of the events that led to his death.
The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman investigated her own. Her mother's diary was in the cold case file. There, she discovered a dark family secret, which might have been the reason her mother vanished.

California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

After a street fight took the life of a national wrestling champion, police had to determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense. A jury decided it was murder and sentenced the accused to a minimum of twenty years in prison.

A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car. The scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.
The body of a young woman was found under an isolated ramp of the Interstate, and a tiny, unique fiber on the victim's clothing led San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.
A man disappeared exactly one year after beginning an affair with his friend's wife.

A Colorado hunter who'd been shot three times was the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspected two weapons and two killers. But analysis of the forensic evidence pointed them in a different direction: one much closer to home.

Hikers near Anchorage, Alaska, discovered a body wrapped in sheets that were edged in orange stitching. Clinging to the sheet, they also discovered a tuft of red carpet fibers, which led them straight to the killer.

A small community is devastated when a car accident claims the life of a well-respected nurse.

The news of a flight attendant's brutal murder prompted the son of a victim who had been killed five years earlier to contact police. Both murders had similar MOs, and analysis of biological evidence proved that these were serial killings.

Judge Beverly Cannone held a hearing on whether an expert witness for the defense could testify to the jury.

Phone records discussed in the trial proceedings revealed a rocky relationship between the defendant and the victim, John O'Keefe.
Karen Read's text and voicemail messages presented to the jury revealed that things were strained between the defendant and her boyfriend, John O'Keefe.

Jurors learned more about John O'Keefe's movements in his last hours alive. Cross-examination began on Trooper Nicholas Guarino who specialized in digital forensics. Karen Read's defense zeroed in on the work that Guarino did in this case.
Karen Read's defense stirred things up with the state trooper on the witness stand.

programmes.t: The Pokerstars Big Game on Tour - Episode 12
programmes.d: Super Bowl champion Rob Gronkowski's dad steps in to make a crucial play. Poker pro Antonio Esfandiari and sports broadcaster Nick Wright trade blows.

Breakout player of the year Rania Nasreddine starts to dominate the table; her fearless style leads to some huge wins and sends Phil Hellmuth over the edge; Loose Cannon Luke makes some risky moves, trying to turn the tide in his favor.

Gronk unleashes chaos; Phil Hellmuth seeks revenge against Rania Nasreddine; Antonio Esfandiari and Nick Wright unite to tilt the Poker Brat to the max; the stakes in this Las Vegas cash game couldn't be higher.

Rob Gronkowski plays the biggest pot of his life, Phil Hellmuth shows why he is a 17-time world champion, and Rania Nasreddine goes head-to-head against Antonio Esfandiari as they compete to be the biggest winner of this high stakes cash game.

In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer.  Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune.  Most ended up dead.  As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage.  The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program.  The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

In February of 1996, New Jersey millionaire Frank Black flew to Florida to close a major business deal before retiring.  He never came home.  Authorities in New Jersey sensed foul play and brought in the FBI.  Agents learned of a mystery woman in Florida who was to meet Black.  Phone records showed a flood of calls to Black from his business rival just before the disappearance.

Twice, police stake out homes where they believe the shooter is hiding, but he eludes them.

In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix.  The following day, the Customs official was found dead.  Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men.   Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder.  Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God.  Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

When police in a small Washington State community began looking into the disappearance of a 22-year-old woman, they had no way of knowing it would evolve into a nationwide hunt for a sexual sadist.  Police knew the killer's identity, but he was a master of disguise.  The FBI was called on to help.  Agents discovered that several unsuspecting women across the northwest had fallen prey to his charms.

In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area.  The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders.  Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes.  The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy.  A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides.  But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed.  After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later.  Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

In 1997, FBI agents began investigating New York gas station mogul Gurmeet Dhinsa for gas pump rigging.  They soon realized that Dhinsa was more than a crooked businessman, he enforced his mob-like operation with brutal violence, kidnapping and killing errant employees and any family members who questioned their deaths.  FBI agents worked their way into Dhinsa's violent world.

programmes.t: DRAGON INN PART 2 : THE NIGHT OF SALVATION [English Sub]
programmes.d: Dragon Inn takes a case of a missing girl. She had no reason to run away from home, which makes the situation quite suspicious. While investigating her case, they find out that a pseudo religion is implicated. Trying to find more information of the girl, Seung-jin makes a mistake and their location and identities are exposed. Will they be able to defeat the cult and save the girl from them?

A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

An action-packed comedy from the producer of Lost In Thailand and Jian Bing Man, Detective Chinatown (Tang Ren Jie Tan An) follows Qin Feng and his second cousin, Tang Ren, Chinatown's top detective, as they investigate a bizarre murder.
A historical drama based on the founding of the Republic of China when nationalist forces led by Sun Yat-sen overthrew the Qing Dynasty.

Detective Sergeant Ma Jun, known for dispensing his own brand of justice during arrests, teams up with an undercover cop, Wilson, to try and bring down three merciless Vietnamese brothers running a smuggling ring in the months before mainland China's takeover of Hong Kong. Jun pursues the gang tirelessly, sometimes ignoring police protocols. A showdown is inevitable!

programmes.t: CREATION OF THE GODS I: KINGDOM OF STORMS [English Dub]
programmes.d: Based on the most well-known classical fantasy novel of China, Fengshenyanyi, the trilogy is a magnificent eastern high fantasy epic that recreates the prolonged mythical wars between humans, immortals and monsters, which happened more than three thousand years ago.

The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind
A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.

A young woman tries to find her origins after having been abandoned as an infant at a cemetery, where she was wrapped in a cloth with satanic symbols. However, as she gets closer to answers, a malevolent spirit tells her to leave.

In the Isan region of Thailand, a shaman realizes that his nephew has been possessed. However, the goddess that appears to have taken possession turns out not to be as benevolent as she first appears.
After moving into a haunted apartment, a shut-in hires a stranger to perform an exorcism.

A professor investigates three chilling and inexplicable cases related to an abandoned asylum, a car accident and the spirit of an unborn child. Even scarier -- each of the macabre tales seems to have a sinister connection to his own life.

Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.
Haunted by eerie images and unexplainable messages, a man (Nicolas Cage) tries to unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of his son.
Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.
Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

A morgue technician reanimates the body of a little girl, but must harvest biological materials from pregnant women to keep her breathing. When the girl's mother, a nurse, discovers her baby is alive, the two make a dark deal.

A teen and her mother live simply in a home in the woods, spending their time making metal music. A chance encounter with a fellow teen causes her to uncover a connection between her family and witchcraft, which causes a rift with her mother.
After a night out, a couple are kidnapped by their black cab driver. Terrified, he drives them to a deserted and supposedly haunted road.
Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.
A disillusioned field surgeon who is suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder makes a man out of body parts and brings him to life in a Brooklyn loft.
A wild animal attacks six grad students on a weekend hike in the woods. One by one, they become infected with an unknown virus that turns them into bloodthirsty creatures.
Malevolent aliens interrupt five collegians' vacation at a remote woodland cabin.
A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.
Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.
Once a victim of vicious bullying, a teenage girl (Sierra McCormick) rises from the grave to punish the tormentors of a new student (Ronen Rubinstein) at a remote school.
A teen and his best friend endure nonstop torment from bullies at school, but that soon changes when one discovers a bloodthirsty creature that resides in a country shed.

When she and her family are attacked by a random stranger one night, a Dutch woman sets out to find an explanation. The more she digs, the more she becomes convinced that she is being hunted by something ancient.

After finding a wounded bird, a girl brings its strange egg home and nurtures it until it hatches. The creature that emerges soon becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare, plunging her into a twisted reality that her mother refuses to see.

As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

Kid's next target is Red Tear, a gem that belongs to the leader of a magic troupe. But just as he changes his mind after realizing something important, Kaito notices that Snake and his henchmen are also after Red Tear. What's a phantom thief to do?
Corbeau the Phantom Thief, a black-clad, dead-ringer for Kid's father, appears and challenges him. Kaito agrees, but if he fails, he'll have to retire as a phantom thief!
In this final episode, Kid goes up against the enigmatic Corbeau one more time as they vie for the jewel that may contain Pandora, which means Snake can't be far behind!

Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.
Kryten, who has been reprogrammed, starts his own pay TV station for the prisoners.
Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.
Lister loses Rimmer in a game of poker to a group of Biologically Engineered Life Forms.
Lister gets himself in a love triangle with Snack Dispensers 23 and 34.
Certain death at the hands of the simulants lead the Dwarfers to wonder if it's the end.
The Dwarfers find themselves in an alternative reality where technology is prohibited.
Lister and Cat get trapped when investigating a shipwreck at the bottom of an ocean moon.
After an altercation with a deranged droid, Lister has his kidneys organ-napped.
After a scandalous piece of good fortune, Rimmer is promoted to being an Officer.
Kryten has a mid-life crisis and changes his body cover from grey to Ferrari red.
Cat takes time off from being in love with himself to fall for a lady Cat.
The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.
The Dwarfers run into a ship where criticism is illegal.
When the machines on Red Dwarf go on strike, a presidential election is held.
The Dwarfers discover that the owners of Red Dwarf have been bought out.
Rimmer looks for another dimension where he is not such a giant loser.
A radiation leak wipes out the crew of the ship Red Dwarf, leaving only one survivor.
Lister is presented with a disappointing vision of his future, but Rimmer is delighted.
Rimmer encounters his most dangerous challenge ever - Lister is taking the chef's exam.
Lister's rather mundane day perks up a little when he discovers he is a God.
Lister contracts a mutated virus and his hallucinations materialise in solid form.
Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.
The crew answer a cry for help from three damsels and an android in distress.
The boys become immersed in the Better than Life reality game.
Lister and Cat wake up with their legs in plaster. What's going on?
The crew of Red Dwarf have found a way to go back in time three million years.
Holly has been deposed and the back-up computer Queeg 500 is in control of Red Dwarf.
Holly's latest invention takes the crew into a bizarre parallel universe.
Time starts to run backwards after the boys travel through a time hole.
Red Dwarf is on a collision course towards a minefield of black holes.
A chameleonic genetic mutant which sucks out human emotions is loose aboard Red Dwarf.
Lister accidentally triggers the ship's self-destruct system.
The crew run amok through history, blithely ignoring the consequences of causality.
Kryten has 24 hours to live, so the crew decide to give him the best night of his life.
Kryten falls in love with a female droid rescued from a crashed vessel.
Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.
Holly, for reasons best known to herself, decides to power down the ship.
In a universe almost identical to our own, another more heroic Arnold Rimmer exists.
A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar sets out to help a young couple's cantankerous Chihuahua, whose recent blindness makes him increasingly hostile to be around. And later, a family makes a desperate plea to Cesar to help them rein in their fast-growing and overexcited Belgian Malinois before he becomes too tough to tame.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar works with a Mexican breed close to his heart when he rehabilitates twin dogs whose over-excited behavior has put their owner at risk of eviction from her apartment building. Later, an actress turns to Cesar for help with an overprotective pint-sized pooch that's creating too much drama of her own.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar helps a family of seven with their young Rottweiler, who's grown aggressive and territorial after a burglary at the family home. With help from his own pack, Cesar instructs the pet parents on techniques to exert leadership behavior and reestablish themselves atop the pack. Parents of a young Pitsky with an overactive prey drive toward their cats look to Cesar for guidance to bring order and harmony into their home.
Cesar Millan walks around his ranch with celebrity dog Loki the Wolfdog.

An interdimensional being believes that Crichton's wormhole knowledge threatens the universe.
After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985, and he has altered the timeline, causing his father to be scheduled to fly on the doomed shuttle Challenger.
The aliens meet an amazed and apprehensive public; Crichton tries to readjust to life on Earth.
Chiana purchases an abused slave girl from a passing trading ship.
Scorpius takes Crichton, D'Argo and Rygel to an advanced training camp where students learn mental discipline.
The women of Moya stumble upon a secret meeting that will change the future of the Uncharted Territories.
The crew travels through a wormhole to Earth in 1985; when Crichton discovers that his father is about to fly the doomed ride with the Challenger, he tries to turn back time.
Crichton and Scorpius travel through a wormhole to a mixed-up version of Moya in search of abducted Aeryn.
Moya's crew traces Aeryn to a freighter at a scarecrow border station; Noranti releases a deadly, contagious virus to keep the vessel in dock.
Moya's crew travels to a heavily guarded Scarran base where Scorpius is being tortured for critical wormhole information.
After thwarting Crichton's escape plan, Scorpius denies he is a Scarran spy.
With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans must travel to Earth through a wormhole as those flowers grow there; with Pilot's help, Crichton tries to collapse the wormhole leading back to Earth.
Astronaut John Crichton is accidentally hurled across a universe and thrust into the middle of a space battle after his ship is swallowed by a wormhole.
Giant space-cockroaches invade the ship, infest the corridors and clog the vents, causing a rise in temperature which endangers Aeryn.
A sensual alien seduces men to obtain a weapon of mass destruction; Crichton experiences mental flashes of the future.
For trade with the Tavleks, Rygel (John Eccleston, Jonathan Hardy) takes a crystal essential to Moya's survival.
Crichton and a female Peacekeeper Tech, left behind by Captain Crais, join forces to save Moya when a race of scavengers attacks.
Crichton must free D'Argo from the influence of a thought-altering plant.
Moya crash-lands on a planet to avoid being traced by the Peacekeepers; Crichton soon realizes that he has become an alien to the inhabitants.
When an evil sorcerer engineers a deadly contest between Crichton and Crais, Zhaan must rouse a dark power within herself to rescue Crichton.
When the crew seeks out a genetic scientist who can provide them with charts to their homeworlds, the scientist secretly injects Aeryn with Pilot's DNA.
After D'Argo suffers a mishap during a maintenance check on Moya, he is tormented by flashbacks; the ship strikes out at the crew.
While gathering data to re-create a wormhole, Crichton and Aeryn are confronted by wolflike bounty hunters in search of Moya's crew.
An invisible net controlled by Zenetan pirates captures Crichton and Aeryn's transport pod and threatens to snare the Moya as well.
When Zhaan tries to aid in curing Tahleen's madness, Tahleen betrays her and reveals Zhaan's dark side.
Crichton stumbles upon the planet of Acquara, an Earth-like paradise where no mechanical devices seem to function after landing.
Mental cleansing changes a Peacekeeper, who once tormented Rygel, into a servile being; with Ben Browder, Gigi Edgley and Tiriel Mora.
Crichton travels through a wormhole that greatly affects Earth, where the entire crew is subjected to intense testing and imprisonment.
Moya tries to starburst to prove to the crew that she still can; it goes slightly wrong though and she gets stuck in starburst, and splits into several different dimensions.
Peacekeeper commandos board the ship after a fuel leak and join the Moya's crew in battle against a deadly virus.
Crichton must infiltrate a Peacekeeper base to save Aeryn's life, but ends up facing torture in an alien electric chair and archenemy Crais.
The crew of the Moya tries to save Crichton from the hands of Crais and the Peacekeepers; with Gigi Edgley and Wayne Pygram.
Moya and her unsuspecting crew encounter a carnivorous alien.

With death approaching in the form of Peacekeeper search parties, those aboard Moya say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before enacting a plan to save Moya and her baby, named Talyn.
Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them; their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.

D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive; during the ritual the Orican draws energy from who she thinks is D'Argo but is actually Moya; consequently Moya starts to age rapidly.
Chiana joins a group of nihilistic teenagers on a cemetery planet.
An alien boards Moya, deranging the crew.
Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot; after seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya.
A fortunetelling portrait acquired from a passing trader turns out to be the tool of an old enemy. With Ben Browder.
Crichton and the crew desperately search for food to nurse an ailing friend back to health, but they may have to sacrifice a friend to save one.
Zhaan, Chiana and Rygel come to grips with the apparent deaths of Crichton, Aeryn and D'Argo.
After an enemy ship fires on Moya, crew members find that their personalities have been switched. With Ben Browder.

programmes.t: A la Orilla de un Palmar
programmes.d: La Fierecilla Domada de Shakespeare es la base argumental de esta película. La acción y los personajes se transladan a un pequeño pueblo rural de la costa mexicana y la acción se adereza con números musicales basados en el folklore local.

La joven y malcriada hija de un ambicioso industrial, lleva relaciones con hombre que se casará con ella por interés. Ella se enamora apasionadamente de antiguo trabajador de fábrica quien ha llegado a convertirse en uno de los principales socios.

programmes.t: Santo En La Venganza De La Momia
programmes.d: Santo se une a una expedición en busca de las ruinas indígenas Opalche. En el viaje lo acompaña unos exploradores. Pronto se encuentran la tumba momificada de Nonoc. Al entrar en la tumba, serán maldecidos por los espíritus que habitan en ella.

In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.
After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.
In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.
At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.
Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.

Hugh's vying to get all of us to start eating more beetroots.

It is party season in Dorset, and Hugh teams up with a local fisherman to catch whelks before spicing them up to sell on the beaches on Carnival Day. Back at The River Cottage HQ, Hugh is inspired to create the West Dorset Tomato Festival.

The day has arrived for Hugh to harvest his honey, and with some help from Ken Bishop, they carefully extract a robust 25 lbs. worth of the golden sweetness. Hugh then enters some culinary delights into the Melplash Agricultural Show.

Hugh plans a sumptuous menu for a special Autumn feast he plans to throw at The River Cottage HQ that includes a chicken feast, courtesy of Chickenopolis. It is also a good time of year to go mushroom hunting, but this time, from the air.

The top 6 Asian fusion takeaways in Ireland put their culinary mastery to the test with the hope that Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Norma Sheehan will advance them into the final cook off.

Plastic waste is becoming a tremendous problem worldwide, and in the Caribbean, the issue can be witnessed firsthand. Also, spend some time with children who use art as a great way to express themselves, and visit a Mayreau place of peace.

It is summer at River Cottage and the vegetables are thriving, so much so that Hugh decides to enter The Beaminster Horticultural Society's annual competition, with the Tomatillo as his secret ingredient. Hugh also fishes for spider crabs.

Hugh discovers that mice are a formidable pest to contend with. Spurred on by this experience, he joins Jan Andrews on a hunt for deer. Hugh then strolls down memory lane with the Cheeseman family and creates a Japanese prawn tempura dish.

It is eel migration season, and Hugh learns how to weave a unique basket trap to catch them in the river. He also joins the Chideock Cider Circle for the fall apple harvest, learns the art of cider pressing, and attends a pheasant hunt.

Hugh has lived in River Cottage for six months, and that means his pigs have a date with butcher Ray Smith. It also means it is time for a party. Hugh also learns a remarkable technique for catching razor clams down by the seashore.

Now that he has some extra land to work with, Hugh purchases some livestock, prompting he and Angus Carmichael, a local carpenter, to build a fox-proof chicken coop. Hugh also goes scallop hunting, and enters a nettle eating competition.

Hugh's cattle and sheep are settling in, but a few of the chickens are not. Also, local vet Jeff Thomson helps with the delicate operation of castrating the calf, Hugh builds a polytunnel, and rabbits wreak havoc on the vegetables.
Britain has largely avoided veal, but Hugh works on changing that opinion.

It is time for Hugh's landlord, Antony Hichens, to host his annual medieval fair, and Hugh decides to donate a pig for the feast. He also helps local bakers create a batch of traditional Dorset lardy cakes and learns hot to shear sheep.

Torrential late summer rains spell doom for Hugh's hay harvest, and only radical plant-surgery can save his tomatoes from blight, however the weather has helped mushrooms flourish. Hugh also enters a sheep in the Melpash Agricultural Show.

Hugh embarks to sell his entire tomato harvest at the Farmer's Market by offering a diverse range of products under the brand name: The River Cottage Glutton. Hugh also makes a bet with a rival grower as to who will sell more at market.

With a failed hay harvest, Hugh conceives a cunning plan to supplement the winter feed he will need for his animals by throwing a party, but instead of a bottle he asks his guests to bring a bale. Hugh also agrees to an unusual request.

It is February at River Cottage, and there is precious little to eat in the pantry. But that does not stop Hugh from building "Chickenopolis." Hugh also navigates the River Brit to the sea, and receives surprising news about his sheep.

Eager to secure fishing rights to the cottage's lake, Hugh makes a wager with his landlord Antony Hichens: If Hugh can prepare a meal of carp that satisfies Antony and his guests, then Hugh shall have fishing rights to the property's lake.
Hugh's vying to get all of us to start eating more beetroots.

It is late May, and there is bad news all around regarding the livestock, but Hugh's spirits are raised when news of cuttlefish hit his ears. At the Shaftesbury Market, Hugh ends up in a bidding war for a calf and ends up paying too much.

Hugh is determined to successfully harvest his own hay this season. He also clears his polytunnel of peas and beans in preparation for the Bridport Farmers' Market, and receives local assistance to turn his wool into fashionable garments.

Hugh summons experts to help deal with his uncooperative livestock, and soon, he feels confident in entering his saddleback, Delia, into the Okehampton Agricultural Show. Hugh also grapples with a serious aphid problem in the polytunnel.

Hugh enters his healthy vegetables into the Vegetable Challenge Cup, but first, to make some cash, he makes a batch of ice-lollies to sell to people on holiday in Dorset, and also takes Delia truffle hunting with a local mycologist.

One of Hugh's ewes has died, and two of his pigs have a date with the abattoir. However, despite all this, Hugh decides to plant roots at River Cottage, and is inspired to plant an orchard. His chickens are also nice and healthy.

As winter nears, Hugh would like to make some money at the Borough Farmers' Market, where he and Michael wind up making a small fortune. Then, after a day of bass fishing, Hugh attends a Halloween Party and partakes in Pumpkin Fettling.

Hugh's new farm is 10 times the size of River Cottage, so he plans to expand production, including setting up a culinary headquarters where he can sell direct to the public, but he soon wonders if he has bitten off more than he can chew.

Several weeks after Hugh leased a collection of barns near his farm to serve as his culinary headquarters, he gives himself a two-week deadline to accomplish the task of getting the muck-ridden buildings up and running by Valentine's Day.
Britain has largely avoided veal, but Hugh works on changing that opinion.

Hugh builds a maternity room for his sow that is moments away from giving birth. He also contemplates how to install plumbing in his new headquarters, and he challenges himself to put the neglected purple broccoli back on the culinary map.

On May Day, Hugh takes advantage of a healthy crowd that gathers on the Cerne Abbas Giant by selling his famous chocolate waffles. It is also opening night at The River Cottage HQ, and Hugh hopes to serve his guests something spectacular.

There are new arrivals on Hugh's farm this spring, including 11 piglets and two baby lambs. Hugh also attends an Easter Blossom Picnic Party, goes mushroom hunting for morells, and gets a crash course in breadmaking from a master baker.

Hugh installs beehives at The River Cottage HQ, the only problem is his fear of being stung. He also takes on his biggest event yet, a wedding party, and the newlyweds want their entire menu to only include wild, or home-grown, cuisine.
